f01d1fa23364d73cebc7.title: Commercial Portfolio Coordinator
f01d1fa23364d73cebc7.description:
**Job Description**

At WSFS Bank, we empower our Associates to grow their careers, guide our Clients to secure their financial futures, and actively support our Communities so they can fully thrive. Careers with WSFS Bank offer an inclusive and supportive culture, competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and more. We are the region's locally headquartered bank and wealth management company. We are honored to consistently be named a Top Workplace by our Associates, who make a difference every day for the people, businesses, and Communities we serve. We Stand For Service® is more than part of our name, it’s our mission and our purpose.

The Commercial Banking Portfolio Coordinator will support assigned Portfolio Managers (PMs) and Relationship Managers (RMs) with certain loan activities related to the processing and closing of commercial loans. This role is responsible for an assigned pipeline of all commercial loan types related to the line of business supported and will act as the Pre-Closing Liaison to an assigned team within the Commercial Division, acting in tandem with the Loan Operations team. The Portfolio Coordinator will ensure all due diligence requirements are satisfied, compliance with WSFS policies, procedures, government regulations, and loan data is accurately reflected in required company operating systems as outlined in final credit approval.

Job Responsibilities:

* Determine due diligence required for each deal. Communicate requirements to relationship team, client, and attorney (as applicable) and plan accordingly to meet scheduled closing date. Act as an escalation point for involved parties to resolve issues and provide training around loan documentation and due diligence.
* Based on preliminary review of loan documents, identify needed modifications to the loan documents or the approval.
* Work with Loan Operations Closers and Flood Specialist to perform validation and confirm due diligence requirements for specific Borrower structures. Validate the KYC status of the customer along based on entity documents to ensure customers are in good standing/registered properly.
* Lend support to the RM in engaging approved external legal counsel and coordinating the closing date, ensuring that date is indicated (and modified when appropriate) on closing calendar, and complete preliminary review of loan documents.
* For all assigned loan closings, work with Portfolio Administrators to ensure that all associated loan fees are reflected accurately. Fees must be processed/collected prescribed timeframes by the PAs, with follow-up performed when needed.
* Communicate and partner effectively with other departments in the Bank and work as a team player to establish exemplary partnerships with all co-workers to create a positive team environment. Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively with third party vendors, customers, RMs, and other internal partners to address discrepancies/issues found during due diligence/loan closing/ongoing review process.
* Possess the ability to meet deadlines by working with multiple RMs on concurrent loan requests, including making ‘last minute’ modifications.
* Support the closing process by confirming loan closing package is ready for funding, ensuring that the package complies with the associated credit approval.
* Assist the RM with the clearance of delinquent documents and other exceptions with appropriate areas post-closing.
* Actively participate in departmental projects and committees as needed.
* Maintain WSFS internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
* Deliver high-quality service, while ensuring accuracy and timeliness of delivery.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Must have a Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or business-related field; or commensurate experience in the commercial banking lending field.
* Minimum of 2 years in Commercial Loan Operations or Commercial Banking loan support is required.
* Must possess knowledge of legal documentation and loan structure. Paralegal experience is a plus.
* Knowledge of banking products and services is required.
* Prior experience with Commercial nCino platform is preferred.
* Proficiency with personal computers as well as pertinent software packages.
* Must possess a strong attention to detail, with the ability to thoroughly interpret financial data and use sound business judgement.
* Must have excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as excellent listening ability and presentation skills.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision, as well as collaborating apart of a team.
* Ability to work under time constraints and handle multiple tasks in support of various assignments.
* Must have the ability to interact and establish good rapport with both internal and external customers.

WSFS Bank will only consider candidates who are presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from WSFS Bank now or in the future in order to retain their authorization to work in the United States.

**Salary Range:**

$53,744.00 - $88,290.50

Individual base pay may vary on additional factors such as the candidate’s experience, job-related skills, relevant education, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

In addition to base salary, WSFS Financial Corporation (WSFS) and its subsidiaries may offer eligible Associates discretionary and formula-based incentive and retention awards. WSFS provides a competitive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; life, accident, and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts (FSAs) and health savings accounts (HSAs); and wellness programs. Additional benefits may include paid parental leave, military leave, vacation and other paid time off, sick leave in accordance with applicable state laws, and paid holidays. Benefit offerings are subject to eligibility requirements, legal limitations, and may vary based on an Associate’s location and employment status. For more information about Associate benefits, please visit https://www.wsfsbank.com/about/careers/

WSFS Bank is inclusive and supportive of individual needs. If you have a physical or other impairment that might require an accommodation, including technical assistance with the WSFS Bank Careers website or submission process, please contact us via email at careers@wsfsbank.com.

WSFS is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The Data Entry & Payroll Specialist is responsible for entering, reviewing, and maintaining customer orders within the Company's ERP systems with a high degree of accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail. This role supports the customer experience and sales process by managing order entry, verifying order information, maintaining data integrity, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring orders are processed in accordance with company standards and procedures.

* Work-Life Balance: Monday – Friday, 8:00am – 5:00pm with occasional overtime and/or weekend work anticipated.

* Compensation: Competitive compensation plan
* Health Benefits: Visual Comfort covers the majority of employee medical premiums, and offers competitive vision and dental coverage available starting the first of the month following your start date.
* Insurance: Company-provided life insurance and short-term disability coverage.
* Retirement: 401(k) plan with company matching up to 4%, available beginning the first of the month following your hire date.

* Enter customer purchase orders, RFQs, and related order information into the Company's ERP system, JDE.
* Review orders for completeness and accuracy, including pricing, quantities, product codes, specifications, shipping instructions, and payment terms.

* Minimum of 3-5 years of order entry, data entry, customer service, sales support, or related administrative experience.

* Strong data entry skills with a demonstrated ability to maintain speed and accuracy.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to quality.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a customer-focused approach.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, manage changing priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Experience in manufacturing, hospitality, design, wholesale/distribution, or related industries, and familiarity with logistics processes, is preferred.

Pay: $24.00 - $27.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

We are currently looking for an **Account Sales Representative (ASR)** to join our Women's Health sales team!

The **ASR** is responsible for service and sales support activities to assist in driving market adoption and business growth. Core responsibilities include supporting the Clinical Field Specialists (CFS) increase revenue and drive market development through direct sales to individual MFMs and OB/GYNs. Support efforts include cultivating and maintaining key relationships, and creating and supporting a strategic business plan to grow revenue quickly. Support efforts will focus on currently marketed products and new product launches.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support CFS with a focus on closing business
* Work with assigned CFS to maintain & support existing customers
* Assess the needs of medical professionals and staff members with a focus on customer support, coordination of logistics, and problem-solving
* Promote quality client/patient relations and create a supportive climate by serving as a role model for other employees
* Respect and maintain the confidentiality of laboratory and financial information
* Practice and adhere to all company policies and regulations
* Follow Compliance procedures and participates in Compliance training
* Perform miscellaneous duties with completion in a designated time frame
* Communicate with Natera staff and its customer to ensure quality
* Maintain and support a service oriented relationship with customers

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 2 years of sales experience
* Background in medical or biological sciences preferred

* Award winning sales professional due to individual achievements
* Exceptionally bright, flexible, self-motivated, and results oriented with strong interpersonal and analytical skills
* Ability to think strategically as well as execute tactically
* Must act with a sense of urgency

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. 1da24642317ef65f4b52.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 23 Oct 2026  
  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio delivers therapies designed to restore, support, and protect every heartbeat through advanced pacing, defibrillation, and remote monitoring solutions. CRM's unique ability to pair proven life-saving therapies with intelligent technology gives clinicians and patients greater confidence. Clinical impact and innovation come together to improve lives through meaningful patient outcomes.  

Provide technical, educational, operational and sales support to assist the district in meeting Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) sales and customer service objectives. CRM seeks collaborative candidates who will meet our customer expectations by striving without reserve for the greatest possible reliability and quality in our products, processes, and systems by being accountable, having a voice and acting promptly.

This role supports the Atlanta territory and requires candidates to reside within the assigned area and travel regularly to customer accounts. Clinical Specialists must be available to support urgent customer needs and participate in weekend, holiday, and occasional after-hours coverage as business needs require. A valid driver's license, active auto insurance, and a driving record that meets company standards are required.

To find all Cardiac Rhythm Management Clinical Specialist roles available please use #crmcs in the key word search at Medtronic Careers

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Provide** technical support for CRM devices and therapies by performing system checks/interrogations, supporting implants, troubleshooting issues, and applying knowledge gained through comprehensive CRM field training.

* **Coordinate** operational support by ensuring accurate patient documentation, managing inventory and equipment resources, maintaining programmer software, and assisting with daily coverage logistics to meet customer and business needs.

* **Educate** physicians, hospital staff, office personnel, and field team members on CRM products, therapies, and solutions, while supporting the onboarding and development of new Clinical Specialists and Sales Representatives.

* **Collaborate** with sales leadership and field partners to understand customer needs, market dynamics, and the value of Medtronic CRM products and solutions.

* **Identify** customer opportunities, support purchase order activities, monitor competitive trends, and provide actionable feedback to help achieve sales objectives.

* **Maintain** technical expertise by staying current on new CRM products, therapies, solutions, and patient management offerings to effectively support customers and clinical outcomes.

* **Travel** extensively within the assigned territory to support customer clinics, hospitals, and business meetings, with frequent independent driving – approximate 80% of the time

* **Perform** physical job requirements, including frequent two-handed lifting of up to **40 lbs.** , sitting, standing, and walking for **8+ hours per day** , and regularly bending, stooping, squatting, and maintaining balance.

* **Work** effectively in clinical environments with exposure to eye protection, infectious disease, and radiation, while wearing **7-9 lbs.** of lead for extended periods, utilizing computers and mobile devices, and maintaining the vision capabilities necessary to support patient care and field-based responsibilities.

* **Performs** other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years **OR** Associate’s Degree PLUS a minimum 4 years **OR** Bachelor’s Degree PLUS a minimum 2 years of work experience in healthcare, field sales, or work experience utilizing complex mathematics, mechanical concepts, science or computing

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in nursing, life sciences, or biomedical engineering

* 2+ years in Cath lab, EP Lab, hospital/clinic with cardiology knowledge

* Thorough working knowledge of medical terminology and the medical device industry

* Expertise with Microsoft tools & other applications (i.e., SalesForce.com)

* Ability to meet vendor credentialing requirements

Ability to coordinate/participate in numerous tasks/projects in a fast-paced environment in an organized manner while meeting deadlines  



For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

===========================

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others).
  
In addition to Base Salary, this position is eligible for a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), which provides the opportunity to earn significant incentive compensation for achieving or exceeding your goals.

**Job Description** :

aba35accaa651791202f.description:
Description:

**Aria Care Partners** is the national leader in providing onsite dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care to over 3500 long-term care and skilled nursing facilities across 25 states. Aria Care Partners believes that our clinicians should be able to focus on providing the best, most comprehensive care for their patients. Our clinicians visit different skilled nursing communities daily, bringing life-affirming care to an underserved population. Our business model, innovation, customer support and teamwork deliver an unparalleled customer experience, resulting in a customer satisfaction rating of over 98%. Executing this strategic philosophy resulted in rapid company growth with revenue increases of 25%-30% annually over the last 4 years, nearly doubling the size of the company. Company values include caring fully for our customers and fellow employees, striving for excellence and continuous improvement, and excelling through the power of teamwork and collaboration. At Aria Care Partners, our mission is to enrich the quality of life for every resident with passion and compassion.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

**THE POSITION**

Aria Care’s innovative collaboration with Medicaid and self-pay approaches can be a tremendous benefit to policy holders. It is the cornerstone of our passionate drive to provide essential healthcare services to an important contingent of our senior population.

Ideal candidates have a health insurance license to sell policies in one or more states, with good communication skills and the ability to sell themselves. Full equipment is provided, and we are offering a competitive base salary plus unlimited commissions with training taking around seven weeks to complete before building up commissions.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Educate prospects on the innovative ways to capture additional insurance coverages for dental, eye care, and auditory that may be little or no cost to the subscriber.
* Create a regular cadence of calls to connect and keep in contact with prospects and others influencing their healthcare decisions.
* Utilize best practices in sales and education guidelines to help maximize the conversion of prospects to the appropriate policies.
* Collaborate with Partners and Clinical Coordinators to address service issues from calls/customers to ensure the quality levels are maintained.
* Updates current database as needed to ensure resident and facility account information is up to date.
* Maintains and enhances product and technical knowledge in the industry.
* Sell Medicare supplemental policies such as Vision, Dental, Audiology and Podiatry.
* Meet or exceed monthly sales targets.
* Performs other job-related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements:

**Education & Experience**

* Must possess a state-issued Health insurance license.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience in selling supplemental policies is preferred i.e. Vision, Dental, Audiology, Podiatry.
* Experience in the healthcare industry with supplemental insurance policies is preferred.
* Experience making outbound calls successfully engaging with prospects.
* Languages:
* Verbal and written fluency in English is required.
* Fluency in secondary languages such as Spanish or Mandarin is a plus.

**Other Qualifications**

* Planning/organizing — Prioritize and plan work activities to use time efficiently.
* Quality control/Attention to detail — Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness; monitor own work to ensure quality and apply feedback to improve performance.
* Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel – Able to use basic functionality in Excel, Word, Outlook and other company-based technology platforms.
* Adaptability — Adapt to changes in the work environment, manage competing demands and deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.
* Dependability — Consistently at work and on time, follow instructions, respond to management direction and solicit feedback to improve performance.
* Problem solving — A passionate pursuit of identifying prospect or client concerns and seeking resolution.
* Customer service — Quickly manage and diffuse difficult client/customer situations, respond promptly to customer needs, solicit customer feedback to improve service, respond to requests for service and assistance and meet commitments.
* Able to work in a team environment.

**Physical Effort & Working Conditions**

Work is performed remotely (home office) or in a normal office setting in our Overland Park, KS headquarters with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards. Substantial time is spent working on a computer.

**Benefits**

* A competitive salary complemented by uncapped commission, offering boundless earning potential!
* Target compensation $80,000-$100,000+
* Comprehensive paid training to kickstart your success.
* Activity based onboarding bonuses for new hires!
* Clear pathways for career advancement, allowing you to shape your professional future.
* Flex scheduling available, ensuring a well-balanced life.

We offer a comprehensive benefit package for you and your family, including:

* PTO and Paid Holidays for FT Employees
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Insurance programs including medical, dental, vision, company match for your HSA, FSA, company-paid EAP, and life and disability insurance, and more.

**Working at Aria Matters!**

1705c885acd081e03264.description:
**Position Summary**

The Internal Services Coordinator is a highly organized and detail-oriented individual contributor responsible for providing administrative, recruiting, training, compliance, and project support across the Internal Services Group. This position serves as a central resource supporting Human Resources, Transportation, Supply Chain, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Risk Management, and Executive Leadership.

  

The Internal Services Coordinator plays a key role in recruiting administration, learning and development program management, driver compliance reporting, organizational reporting, project coordination, and cross-functional administrative support. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, initiative, professionalism, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a commitment to confidentiality.

  

**Core Duties & Responsibilities**

**Recruiting Administration**

* Manage job postings across recruiting platforms including BambooHR, Indeed and other sourcing channels.
* Coordinate candidate communications, interview scheduling, and hiring manager follow up.
* Conduct applicant screening and initial qualification reviews.
* Maintain applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics.
* Support pre-employment activities including background checks, MVR reviews, and onboarding coordination.
* Oversee I-9 documentation, EEO reporting and metrix.
* Prepare recruitment reports and workforce planning updates.
* Assist with recruiting campaigns, hiring events, and talent pipeline initiatives.
* Manage new hire orientation scheduling and compliance.

**Learning & Development Administration**

* Manage the company's Learning & Development platform.
* Assign training programs and monitor completion status.
* Generate training compliance reports for leadership.
* Maintain employee learning records and certifications.
* Support development initiatives, leadership training programs, and company learning campaigns.
* Assist with administration of mandatory compliance training.

**Driver Qualification & Compliance Support**

* Coordinate and maintain Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring processes.
* Conduct biannual MVR reviews for applicable field personnel.
* Track license expirations and driving record requirements.
* Maintain driver qualification files and compliance documentation.
* Assist with DOT-related administrative tracking and reporting.
* Coordinate quarterly random D&A requirements.

**Internal Services Administrative Support**

Provide administrative support to:

* Transportation Supervisor
* Supply Chain Coordinator
* HSE Manager
* Director of Risk Management
* Chief Operating Officer

Responsibilities may include:

* Scheduling meetings and coordinating calendars.
* Preparing reports, presentations, and meeting materials.
* Maintaining records, logs, and departmental documentation.
* Assisting with vendor communications and data collection.
* Tracking departmental action items and project deliverables.
* Supporting audits, compliance reviews, and operational initiatives.

**Project Coordination**

* Assist in planning and coordinating special projects across the Internal Services Group.
* Maintain project trackers and status updates.
* Coordinate information gathering from multiple departments.
* Follow up on deadlines, deliverables, and action items.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and process documentation.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare recurring reports for HR, Safety, Transportation, and Executive Leadership.
* Compile workforce metrics, recruiting data, training compliance statistics, and operational reports.
* Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, and tracking tools.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of organizational data.

**General Responsibilities**

* Work safely and follow all company policies and procedures.
* Champion EnerStar's Core Values.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding employee and company information.
* Build collaborative relationships across departments.
* Support organizational objectives and special assignments as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

  

**Position Requirements**

**Education**

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Project Management, or related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* 2+ years of administrative, HR, recruiting, project coordination, or business support experience preferred.
* Experience supporting multiple departments or leaders is an asset.
* Experience with learning management systems or training platforms preferred.
* Experience with BambooHR, BizLibrary, DISA, Novara Flex / KPA preferred.

  

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prepare reports and analyze data.
* Strong customer service mindset.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
* Strong problem-solving and follow-through skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

This position is responsible for providing high volume call center support and best in class customer service to patients and health care providers. This role will be responsible for educating patients on the enrollment process, handling status inquiries along with scheduling deliveries. This position uses the core CRM system to manage workload, perform activities and route work to other members of the team.

Responsibilities

* Provide subject matter expertise of program requirements and application status while maintaining a high level of customer service, sense of urgency, reliability, data entry skills, active listening, proper phone etiquette, great verbal and writing skills, and teamwork spirit
* As the initial point of contact for patients and HCP’s that we support guide callers through the application process to determine resolution of inquiry
* Ensure correct information or directs the call to the appropriate team member while maintaining a high level of professionalism
* Provides typed documentation of all communications received from calls and provides notification of any urgent orders, shipping related issues and any errors, complaints or adverse drug events to the appropriate party or system
* Identifies potential Adverse Event situations for reporting to Pharmacovigilence ensuring  
  AbbVie meets FDA regulations
* Meet performance standards in alignment with predefined metrics
* Completes all required training in order to perform all functions in the position e.g., soft skills certification along with program overviews

  
**Qualifications**  

* High School Diploma or GED required. Associate or College Degree Preferred
* Previous experience in a call center environment, healthcare office, corporate setting, or  
  healthcare insurance provider or pharmacy is highly desirable
* Understanding and knowledge of commercial and major medical insurance programs, billing  
  requirements, healthcare benefit investigation processes, prior authorization and appeal  
  filings
* Knowledge of private payers, pharmacy benefits, medical benefits, Medicare Part D, Medicaid and alternate funding resources
* Demonstrated organization and problem solving skills to handle patient conversations identify issues and address needs
* Must have comfort level with utilizing multiple applications while capturing case information
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Program Suite and Lotus Notes Suite including  
  Excel, Word, Outlook and SharePoint
* Ability to maintain professional communication skills and an understanding of how to  
  maintain a courteous attitude toward customers and fellow employees
* Requires critical thinking skills, analytical skills and the ability to work with minimal supervision. Requires strong communication (verbal and written, clear and concise), customer service and interpersonal skills
* Must be able to take appropriate action in a stressful environment

  
**Additional Information**

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:

This range may be modified in the future.

* This job is eligible to participate in our short-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

58680fd7c3a48bde5283.title: BRANCH COORDINATOR - Remote
58680fd7c3a48bde5283.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Our Branch Coordinators positively impact the lives of patients and their caregivers, by phone and in person, delivering excellent customer service during each interaction. Working collaboratively with patients, providers and other team members, Branch Coordinators ensure orders are received and processed timely, efficiently, and accurately. Branch Coordinators play an important role in ensuring Apria is paid for the services we provide by obtaining all necessary documentation required to bill health insurance plans.

  

***The anticipated salary range for this position is $19.60 - $20.96 (Hourly). The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.***

***This is a Remote/Working from Home position.***

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Act as first point of contact to patients arriving in person.
* Answer inbound calls from customers on a multi-line phone system; provide information to new and existing patients, troubleshoot common issues, work with the branch team and other departments to find appropriate resolutions and escalate queries or concerns when necessary.
* Perform processing duties for the branch; including, but not limited to, creating, and working with new orders, reviewing multiple systems simultaneously to assist customers, confirming delivery appointments, verifying insurance, obtaining authorization of equipment based on payor guidelines, monitoring incoming faxes, and performing data entry.
* Work with sales team, referrals and/or patients to gather documentation/information needed to meet insurance guidelines. Requests health plan authorizations/information as required; either electronically or verbally.
* Review of new and recurring patient accounts, obtain all necessary documentation from the referral source to bill the individual health insurance plans, allowing our patients to maximize their available health plan benefits and to receive the much-needed care as soon as possible.
* Collect credit card payments and billing information, reconcile daily receivables, and submit to the lock box.
* Perform outbound customer satisfaction calls to patients and referrals.
* May conduct downloads of recording devices such as apnea monitors, oximeters, CPAP devices and other respiratory equipment.
* May perform functional tests on certain respiratory equipment.
* Performs other duties as required.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* None

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

**Education and/or Experience**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* At least one-year related work experience

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations**

* None

**SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES**

* Organizing
* Problem Solving/Analysis
* Patient Focused
* Teamwork
* Time Management/Multi-tasking
* Effective communication in person, on the phone and electronically

**Computer Skills**

* Intermediate to advanced computer skills
* Proficient working within multiple systems at once

**Language Skills**

* English (reading, writing, verbal)

**Mathematical Skills**

* Intermediate level math skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and/or Experience**

* At least two years’ experience in an office environment, healthcare setting or call center
* Experience utilizing multi-line phone-system.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear.

* The employee uses computer and telephone equipment.
* Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision.
* Regularly required to use hands to write, use computer or handheld device (tablet), telephone and use a document imaging system and manipulate documents.

* Regularly required to read documents and write neatly, legibly and transcribe accurate information and numbers/values.
* Employee continually engages in activities that require talking and hearing.
* This position requires frequent variations including sitting, walking, standing, kneeling, reaching or stooping.
* Strength Aspects:
  + Occasionally required to stand, lift, push or pull objects ranging from 10 lbs - 40 lbs.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

Work is performed in an office setting with exposure to moderate noise and indoor florescent lighting.  

  

**The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.**

**Teammate Benefits**

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

Our benefits program includes:

* Medical, dental, and vision care coverage

* Paid time off plan
* 401(k) Plan
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Basic life insurance
* Short-and long-term disability coverage
* Accident insurance
* Teammate Assistance Program
* Paid parental leave
* Domestic partner benefits
* Mental, physical, and financial well-being programs

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.

Accendra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, disability, age, status as a veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

*Note: Accendra is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our Company via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our Company. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by our Company as a result of the referral or through other means.*

2ab3757efc4823a2237a.title: UM Coordinator, Inpatient (Remote | Part-Time Weekends | PT | Weekday Training Required)
2ab3757efc4823a2237a.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Alignment Health is seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and customer service-oriented remote UM Coordinator (inpatient) to join our UM team. This is a part-time weekend role that requires availability every Saturday and Sunday during Pacific Time hours. As an Inpatient UM Coordinator, you will assist with managing census and admissions, retrieving medical records, and supporting discharge planning while working closely with the Case Management (CM) Supervisor, Manager, and Director of Healthcare Services.  
  
If you are hungry to learn and grow, want to be part of a growing organization, and make a positive impact in the lives of seniors, we're looking for you!  
  
Work Schedule (Required)  

* Every Saturday and Sunday
* Option A: 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time
* Option B: 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM Pacific Time

  
Mandatory Training Availability (Required):  

* This position requires 4 weeks of mandatory weekday training
* Training is Monday through Friday, 4 hours per day, scheduled within the hours of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
* Specific training hours may vary based on trainer availability and business needs
* Attendance is required throughout the full 4-week training period

  
Candidates must be able to accommodate 4 hours of training each weekday within the 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time training window before transitioning to the regular weekend schedule.

**GENERAL DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist team with daily census by entering face sheets for hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNF).
* Obtain medical records from hospitals and SNF’s.
* Attach medical records to authorizations.
* Enter referral requests / authorizations in system using ICD 10 and CPT coding.
* Monitor fax folders.
* Complete and document tasks as assigned by nurse.
* Maintain documentation on facilities contacted.
* Assist with maintaining and updating member’s records.
* Assist with mailing or faxing correspondence to facilities, related to, as needed.
* Request medical records from facilities, etc., related to members activities, as needed.
* Attend case management presentations and participates, as appropriate.
* Recognize work-related problems and contributes to solutions.
* Meet specific deadlines and respond to various workloads by assigning task priorities according to department policies, standards and needs.
* Maintain confidentiality of information between and among health care professionals.
* Be a positive team player.

**Job Requirements:**

**Experience:**

Required:

* Inpatient concurrent review experience
* Experience with census and admission management
* Experience in discharge planning
* Experience entering referrals and prior authorizations.
* Experience with Medicare Advantage
* Experience with hospital and / or facilities backend admissions
* Knowledge of medical terminology
* Knowledge of ICD10 and CPT codes
* Knowledge of Medicare, HMO, MMO, managed care plans
* Computer proficient

f7870be806054111d088.description:
**Company Overview**

Melone Hatley, P.C. is a fast-growing family and estate planning law firm with offices across Virginia, Florida, South Carolina, and Texas. Named one of the 500 fastest-growing law firms in the United States and recognized by Super Lawyers, we've built our reputation on delivering compassionate, high-quality legal services and creating a workplace where talent thrives.

Our mission is simple: to be the premier law firm for individuals looking to protect what matters most — their families, their finances, and their future. We achieve this by fostering a culture rooted in transparency, integrity, and open communication. Every team member plays a vital role in delivering personalized, results-driven support to our clients, and we're proud to be known as one of the top employers in the region.

Join us and become part of a team that is redefining family and estate law with purpose, passion, and people at the center of everything we do.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a driven and results-oriented Inside Sales Representative - Client Services Coordinator to join our team. This role is essential for converting incoming leads into new business opportunities while providing exceptional customer experiences. As a first point of contact for prospective clients, you will shape their initial impressions of our firm and play a vital role in our growth. This position is based in our Virginia Beach office, but remote work options are available. If you thrive in a fast-paced, competitive sales environment and are passionate about helping others, we want to hear from you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Generate new sales opportunities by reaching out to inbound leads via phone calls and follow-up emails.
* Use active listening and effective interviewing techniques to identify and understand client needs.
* Achieve and exceed sales closure goals on a quarterly basis.
* Collaborate with internal teams to build a robust sales pipeline and facilitate successful deal closures.
* Maintain accurate records in our Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, tracking lead progress and interactions.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Minimum of 1 year of proven experience in inside sales, *required.*
* Proven track record of exceeding sales goals and targets.
* Strong phone presence, with the ability to make numerous phone calls per day.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Teams, Word).
* Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools such as HubSpot.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong active listening, problem-solving and presentation abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work efficiently under deadlines.
* Some college education, *preferred.*

**Compensation:**

* Base Salary: $40,000 per year
* Bonus Opportunities: Monthly and quarterly incentives
* **Total Compensation Potential:** $75,000 - $100,000 per year and beyond

**Benefits:**

* 100% Employer Paid Medical Benefits for Employees and Dependents
* Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401 (k) Matching
* Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay

**Work Environment:**

* Full-time position (8-hour shift)
* Monday through Friday, rotating Saturday shifts
* Remote

**Join Our Team!**

If you are an ambitious sales professional passionate about helping clients and making a difference, we invite you to apply to join the team at Melone Hatley, P.C. Together, let us help families navigate their legal journeys with confidence and compassion.

286b523056bd4b33dfbe.title: Territory Sales Representative / Project Manager
286b523056bd4b33dfbe.description:
THIS POSITION IS BASED IN BROWARD COUNTY. Playmore Recreational Products & Services, located in Fort Myers, FL, is the leader in the design, sales, and installation of park and recreation equipment throughout the State of Florida. Our products include commercial playground equipment, park and site amenities, shelters and pavilions, as well as many other products for the park and recreation equipment buyer.

**Key responsibilities**

Generated by AI

* Prospect daily for new business opportunities and close projects with municipalities, schools, churches, HOAs, developers, and contractors.
* Manage projects from signed contract through completion, coordinating with installers, subcontractors, vendors, and customers.
* Conduct site visits, monitor schedules and deliveries, resolve issues, and hold timelines accountable while continuing to prospect for new sales.

**Job description**

**Playmore Recreational Products + Services**, based in Fort Myers, FL, is hiring a Territory Sales & Project Manager to develop new business and manage commercial playground and park projects throughout the Fort Lauderdale Area. Position is home based with extensive travel throughout territory.

This is a hybrid role combining:

* Outside sales
* Project management
* Construction coordination

We are looking for someone who can aggressively prospect for new business, close projects, and manage those projects through installation and completion.

This is not a position for someone who only wants to sell and hand projects off.

We need someone who is highly motivated, organized, accountable, and capable of producing sales results quickly.

You will be expected to own the process from initial customer contact through final installation.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Sales & Business Development**

* Prospect daily for new business opportunities
* Build relationships with municipalities, schools, churches, HOAs, developers, and contractors
* Conduct site visits, presentations, and meetings
* Develop proposals and close projects
* Manage a strong sales pipeline
* Generate consistent new business activity throughout your territory
* Meet sales expectations and begin producing results early in the role

This is a true hunter sales position. Candidates must be comfortable creating opportunities through outbound effort, networking, follow-up, and relationship development.

**Construction & Project Coordination**

* Manage projects from signed contract through completion
* Coordinate with installers, subcontractors, vendors, and customers
* Monitor schedules, deliveries, and site readiness
* Conduct jobsite visits and installation meetings
* Resolve issues and keep projects moving
* Manage multiple active projects while continuing to prospect and sell
* Hold timelines and project partners accountable

Candidates do not need to be construction experts, but they must be comfortable managing construction-related projects, schedules, contractors, and installation coordination.

**Who We’re Looking For**

**The ideal candidate is:**

* Self-motivated
* Organized
* Competitive
* Responsive
* Comfortable managing moving parts and construction-related projects
* Driven to produce sales results quickly

**Candidates with experience in the following industries are strongly preferred:**

* Commercial construction sales
* Site development
* Landscape or hardscape construction
* Recreation or playground sales
* Athletic equipment
* Outdoor commercial products
* Contractor or subcontractor coordination

Experience working with municipalities, schools, contractors, developers, or construction-related customers is a major plus.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of outside sales experience
* Hunter mentality with proven business development success
* Documented history of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Strong communication and follow-through
* Ability to manage projects and timelines
* Comfortable with contractors, jobsites, and field coordination
* Valid driver’s license
* Ability to travel daily throughout the territory

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission
* Compensation is designed to reward both new business development and successful project execution
* Year 1 On-Target Earnings: $100,000+
* Year 2 On-Target Earnings: $125,000+
* On-target earnings can exceed projections for high performers who consistently produce results
* Top performers earn $200,000+
* 401(k) Matching
* Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
* Mileage Reimbursement
* Cell Phone
* Paid Time Off

High performers who can successfully manage both sales growth and project execution have significant long-term income potential.

**Internal Team Support**

**You will work closely with:**

* Business Development Manager
* Design & Proposal Team
* Inside Installation Coordinator
* Outside Installers & Subcontractors

Strong communication and accountability are critical for success in this role.

Job Types: Full-time, Commission

Pay: $100,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

a2f083f6e70e983e005d.title: Corporate Travel Coordinator
a2f083f6e70e983e005d.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

Neogen is seeking an experienced **Corporate Travel Coordinator** to support global business travel across the organization.

This role will coordinate domestic and international corporate travel, support employees with Concur Travel and Concur Expense, manage complex travel logistics, and partner with vendors to help ensure efficient, cost-effective, and consistent travel experiences.

The Corporate Travel Coordinator will work closely with employees, leaders, supervisors, travel vendors, hotels, airlines, and other external partners to support individual and group travel for conferences, trade shows, meetings, and other business needs. The successful candidate will be highly organized, collaborative, service-oriented, and comfortable managing confidential information and multiple travel priorities across a global organization.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

In this role, you will make an impact by:

* Coordinating domestic and international corporate travel, including airfare, lodging, ground transportation, and related travel needs
* Supporting employees with travel arrangements for trade shows, conferences, meetings, customer visits, and other business activities
* Coordinating group travel and complex itineraries for multiple employees or teams
* Serving as a support resource for employees experiencing issues with **Concur Travel** or **Concur Expense**
* Troubleshooting Concur-related questions and helping employees navigate travel booking, expense reporting, and related processes
* Developing and delivering training, guidance, and job aids for employees on the effective use of **Concur Travel** and **Concur Expense**
* Providing individual and group training and support related to travel booking, expense reporting, travel policies, and system best practices
* Identifying recurring employee questions or system issues and developing training materials or process documentation to improve employee knowledge and system adoption
* Using **Sabre** to support corporate travel activities
* Partnering with employees and supervisors to coordinate travel plans, schedules, and business requirements
* Working with travel vendors, hotels, airlines, and transportation providers to resolve issues and support traveler needs
* Negotiating rates, terms, contracts, and service agreements with hotels, airlines, travel vendors, and other suppliers
* Supporting vendor selection and relationship management to improve service, cost, and traveler experience
* Monitoring travel reservations and assisting with changes, cancellations, disruptions, and urgent travel needs
* Maintaining accurate traveler information, itineraries, confirmations, and related documentation
* Supporting international travel requirements, including coordination of passports, visas, and other travel documentation as appropriate
* Ensuring travel arrangements align with Neogen travel policies, processes, and cost expectations
* Supporting administration and continuous improvement of Neogen’s corporate travel and expense program
* Identifying opportunities to improve travel processes, traveler experience, vendor performance, and cost management
* Maintaining strict confidentiality when handling employee, leadership, travel, financial, and business information
* Collaborating with Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Administrative teams, supervisors, and business leaders across the organization
* Supporting travel reporting, reconciliation, and other administrative activities as needed
* Assisting with special projects and other corporate travel responsibilities as assigned

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent
* **5+ years of experience in corporate travel coordination, corporate travel management, or a closely related business travel function**
* Experience using **Concur Travel**
* Experience using **Concur Expense**
* Experience using **Sabre**
* Experience providing employee support or help desk-style assistance for travel or expense systems
* Experience coordinating domestic and international corporate travel
* Experience coordinating group travel for conferences, trade shows, meetings, or other business events
* Experience working directly with hotels, airlines, travel agencies, or other travel vendors
* Experience negotiating vendor rates, contracts, terms, or service agreements
* Strong organizational and time-management skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple travel requests, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, vendors, and stakeholders across different functions and geographic regions
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee, travel, financial, and business information appropriately
* Ability to collaborate closely with a supervisor and coordinate work across multiple stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Associate or bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Travel and Tourism, Communications, or a related field
* Experience supporting travel within a global organization
* Experience supporting executive or leadership travel
* Experience working with a corporate travel management company
* Experience negotiating hotel blocks, airline agreements, or group travel arrangements
* Experience supporting international visa, passport, or entry documentation processes
* Experience with corporate travel policy administration
* Experience with travel reporting, expense reconciliation, or travel analytics
* Experience supporting meetings, conferences, trade shows, or large-scale company events
* Experience developing or delivering employee training on **Concur Travel, Concur Expense, or other corporate travel and expense platforms**

**What Will Help You Succeed**
------------------------------

* Strong customer service mindset
* Excellent organization and follow-through
* Ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, and external partners
* Ability to remain calm and responsive when travel plans change unexpectedly
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to anticipate traveler needs and identify potential issues before they become problems
* Professional and approachable communication style
* Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential information
* Ability to coordinate multiple priorities across different time zones
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, global environment
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability

At **Neogen** we believe that taking care of our employees allows them to do their best work. When you join our team, you'll enjoy competitive benefits and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference every day.

**Benefits include:**

* **Benefits starting on Day One** – Medical, dental, and vision coverage begin on your first day of employment.
* **401(k) with company match** – Invest in your future with retirement savings and company contributions.
* **Paid Time Off (PTO)** – Enjoy generous paid time off so you can rest, recharge, and spend time with those who matter most.
* **Career Growth Opportunities** – We are committed to promoting from within and providing the tools, training, and support to help you grow your career.
* **Meaningful Work** – Be part of a team whose work has a real impact on our customers, communities, and the world around us.
* **Collaborative Culture** – Join a team that values innovation, respect, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**Come Be Part of a Mission That Matters**
------------------------------------------

At Neogen, our mission is to protect the world’s food supply. Our products and solutions support customers across food safety, animal safety, diagnostics, and related industries around the world.

Joining Neogen means becoming part of a global organization where your work helps employees travel effectively, supports critical business activity, and contributes to a mission that matters.

**Come build your future with us while making a difference every day.**

**#Applynow**

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

ec04dc778505612c3102.title: Precision Account Manager - Oncology - Atlanta/Nashville
ec04dc778505612c3102.description:
**Company Description**

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 6,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

 **Job Description**

**Field-Based - Precision Account Manager.** The Precision Account Manager (PAM) is a field-based oncology account role responsible for educating a multidisciplinary team of cancer and digestive system specialists and their staff who treat patients with FGFR2-positive cholangiocarcinoma about an available treatment for this condition. The PAM will manage a defined geography and engage oncologists, gastrointestinal oncology specialists, gastroenterologists, hepatobiliary specialists, pathologists, pharmacists, advanced practice providers, nurses, molecular diagnostics stakeholders, financial counselors, and appropriate office staff. The role requires experience navigating academic medical centers, cancer institutions, organized systems of care, and complex account environments.

The PAM will develop and execute account plans, deliver accurate and compliant scientific and product education, support appropriate patient identification through molecular testing awareness, and coordinate internal resources to address account needs. Success requires strong oncology clinical acumen, strategic account management, cross-functional collaboration, customer-focused execution, and consistent adherence to all legal, regulatory, and company requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Manage an assigned geography and achieve or exceed established sales objectives and brand performance expectations in a compliant and ethical manner.
* Create, build, and maintain professional relationships with academic medical centers, cancer institutions, integrated delivery networks, community oncology practices, key opinion leaders, account influencers, and other healthcare stakeholders.
* Educate multidisciplinary customer teams on the disease state, FGFR2 alterations, the role of comprehensive molecular profiling, appropriate patient identification, and the approved product using company-approved resources and messaging.
* Conduct high-quality face-to-face and virtual customer engagements, including formal and informal presentations that clearly communicate complex clinical, molecular testing, access, reimbursement, and patient-support information.
* Develop and execute robust territory and account plans that identify account priorities, treatment pathways, diagnostic workflows, key stakeholders, barriers to appropriate use, and opportunities to improve customer and patient support.
* Understand account-level processes for molecular testing, pathology coordination, specialty pharmacy fulfillment, patient access, reimbursement, HUB services, and patient support, and connect customers with appropriate resources.
* Partner cross-functionally with Precision Oncology leadership, Medical Science Liaisons, Market Access, National or Strategic Accounts, Marketing, Sales Operations, Training, and Patient Services to deliver coordinated account support.
* Mobilize company resources appropriately while maintaining clear role boundaries between commercial and medical functions.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2 fusions, relevant treatment modalities, competitor activity, emerging oncology trends, and the evolving business environment.
* Provide relevant field and customer insights to leadership and internal partners regarding disease awareness, diagnosis, molecular testing, treatment education, account needs, tools, and product messaging.
* Use customer relationship management and other company systems to document customer interactions, maintain account plans, manage follow-up activities, and support effective territory execution.
* Analyze business trends, account dynamics, claims or other approved data, and territory performance to prioritize activities and inform strategic decision-making.
* Manage territory resources and promotional budgets within company guidelines; complete required reports, training, administrative responsibilities, and expense submissions accurately and on time.
* Participate in relevant medical meetings, conferences, speaker programs, and local educational initiatives consistent with company policy.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.

#LI-CG1

 **Qualifications**

**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university required; business, life sciences, or clinical discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostic, or medical sales experience, including significant oncology experience. Demonstrated experience calling on academic medical centers, cancer institutions, and other complex oncology accounts is required.
* Understanding of biomarker-driven oncology, molecular testing, pathology workflows, and the role of comprehensive genomic profiling in identifying appropriate patients.
* Ability to learn and communicate complex oncology, cholangiocarcinoma, FGFR2, and product information accurately and confidently.
* Experience engaging oncologists, gastrointestinal specialists, pathologists, pharmacists, advanced practice providers, nurses, diagnostic stakeholders, and office-based support staff.
* Proven ability to map complex accounts, identify decision-makers and influencers, develop account-specific strategies, and coordinate resources across organized systems of care.
* Documented record of strong sales performance, effective launch execution, and achievement of business objectives is preferred.
* Strong presentation, business communication, and customer-centric selling skills, with the ability to convey complex scientific and business information to varied audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret approved sales, market, claims, and account data and translate insights into focused territory actions.
* Working knowledge of oral specialty pharmacy, payer and reimbursement dynamics, patient support programs, and HUB services in oncology is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively across commercial, medical, market access, operations, and patient-services teams in a matrixed environment.
* Proficiency with Veeva or a comparable CRM platform and Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Demonstrated commitment to operating within all company policies, industry standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company driving requirements. Ability to travel extensively within the assigned geography, including overnight travel.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Advanced degree in business, life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or another relevant discipline.
* Experience in gastrointestinal oncology, hepatobiliary cancers, rare disease, molecular diagnostics, precision oncology, or biomarker-driven therapy.
* Product launch experience, particularly in a rare oncology indication or with an oral specialty product.
* Established relationships within major academic medical centers, National Cancer Institute- designated cancer centers, or leading regional cancer institutions.
* Experience working across integrated oncology networks, organized customers, and complex institutional accounts.

  
**Additional Information**

**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS**

**Patient Minded** I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

**Client Delight** I own every client experience and its impact on results.

**Take Action** I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

**Embrace Diversity** I create an environment of awareness and respect.

**Grow Talent** I own my development and invest in the development of others.

**Win Together** I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

**Communication Matters** I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful, and timely dialogue.

**Always Innovate** I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. If this job posting includes a base salary range, it represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). This role is eligible for hire in select U.S. locations based on business and operational considerations. For a full list of locations, visit eversana.com/careers. More information about EVERSANA’s benefits package can be found at eversana.com/careers. EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range and benefits at any time.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodations applies to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the interview and hiring process, please contact us at applicantsupport@eversana.com.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter
