9e9f63ba5d9a153984aa.description:
Feast Your Eyes is seeking an experienced, hands-on Catering Staffing Coordinator to schedule and train front-of-house servers and bartenders at a high-volume off-premise catering company serving weddings, corporate, nonprofit, cultural, social, and large-scale special events throughout the Greater Philadelphia region.

Feast Your Eyes is a premier catering company based in Philadelphia. Founded in 1982, Feast provides full-service and drop-off catering for events of all sizes and styles. Our team focuses on the entire event experience, making sure that the design, service staff, and menu all work together to elevate the event. With our pulse on the global culinary scene and a team of chefs with diverse backgrounds, Feast combines the best of international fare with our favorite Philly trends.

The Staffing Coordinator reports directly to the Chief of Staff and interfaces regularly with Chief Executive Officer/Owner, Executive Chef and members of the senior sales team.

**Role Overview**  
Responsible for recruiting, training, management, and scheduling of front of-house staff for catered events. Additionally, works with kitchen management to assist in the hiring and scheduling of kitchen staff on catered events.

**Duties/Responsibilities**  
**Staff Scheduling**

* Export events and staffing requests from sales database into scheduling software.
* Verify the accuracy and completeness of staff requests to ensure Event Staff have the necessary information to arrive at the correct location at the correct time with the correct resources.
* Prepare and organize work schedules for Event Staff to make sure that the required number of appropriately skilled staff attend each event.
* Respond to last minute and emergency changes to the Event Staff schedule due to the rapidly changing needs of clients and availability of staff.
* Partner with 3rd party staffing vendors to supplement Feast staff as necessary.
* Coordinate kitchen event scheduling with Executive Chef and Kitchen Manager.
* Attend event walkthroughs and production meetings as requested.

**Event Staff Management**

* Take responsibility as the primary point of contact for all Event Staff and staff vendors which includes availability and an expectation of response during off-hours, nights, and weekends.
* Assist in the recruiting, hiring, and training of all Event Staff.
* Practice appropriate methods of documentation while coaching or taking corrective action with employees. Ensure that Event Staff is adhering to Company policy and procedures and consistently document disciplinary actions taken.
* Manage uniforms for team, including ordering, shipping to employees and payroll deductions.

**Event Execution**

* Supervise and/or assist on average two events per week to oversee and direct staff and to ensure that event execution and staffing meets client and management expectations.
* Attend events with a focus of continuing education both in a supervisor, server, and bartender capacity.
* Uphold a positive attitude and professional manner while working with clients, guests, staff and vendors.

**Front-of-House Training**

* Ensure all Front of House team members and event staff are up-to-date on Feast standards for event execution and customer experience, including being well-versed in the event's details; using clear, courteous communication; and delivering hospitality best practices.

**Key Skills & Expertise**

* Able to consistently exceed guest expectations and have an uncompromising approach to service and follow through.
* Demonstrate a passion for the hospitality industry.
* Strong attention to detail
* Strong writing, communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong computer skills, including working knowledge of employee schedule and time tracking software
* Professional attitude, appearance, and demeanor.
* Able to work with people at all levels.
* Able to effectively problem solve complex challenges and get positive results.
* Ability to prioritize work assignments and adapt to changing priorities.

**Education & Experience**

* 3-5 years of catering and/or event experience, specifically working event staff scheduling, assignments, and communications.

**Physical Requirements**

* Able to work a flexible schedule including days, nights, weekends and holidays.
* Able to work in varying elements, including indoors and outdoors, uneven walking surfaces/terrain, locations with stairs
* Able to lift, carry and move materials weighing 35 pounds or more at times.

**Compensation**

* Base hourly rate plus additional rate when working off-premise catered events.
* Full time position with health care, paid time off, cell phone credit, 401K with company match.

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

Advanced Infusion Care, a division of AIS Healthcare, is the leading provider of Home Infusion Therapy. With our diverse culture, and our values around Innovation, Stewardship, and Unity, we are committed to Advancing Quality, and Improving Lives. We are dedicated to doing more for our patients by providing quality products and services that enhance the entire care experience.

Advanced Infusion Care is looking for an experienced and motivated Intake Coordinator to join our dynamic team! The Intake Coordinator role is a full-time position responsible for providing patient access to the medication and therapies needed by contacting insurance companies and verifying the patient’s health insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage/non-coverage information and initiation/extension of authorizations.

The perfect candidate should have outstanding communication and time management skills, extreme attention to detail and accuracy, have in-depth knowledge of insurance benefit verification, and work in compliance with Federal and State rules and regulations.

AIS Healthcare offers great benefits, including health, vision and dental insurance, long term disability insurance, life insurance, a vacation package, 401K plan with a generous employer match, remote work from home opportunity, growth, and more!

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

A high school diploma or general education degree (GED) equivalent is required; minimum 2 years’ experience in customer service, medical billing and coding, benefits verification, healthcare, or similar vocations. Specifically seeking experience with California payers.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Conduct comprehensive benefit investigation for new patient referrals. Evaluate pharmacy benefit plans and medical benefit plans.

* Participate in any variety of meetings and work groups to integrate activities, communicate issues, obtain approvals, resolve problems and maintain specified level of knowledge pertaining to new developments, requirements, and policies.

* Train new and existing associates in the use of pharmacy software system, supplemental applications, customer service techniques, job responsibilities, and departmental workflow.

* Identify deviations from training and/or processes during normal work activity.

* Serve as the SME for new applications, software upgrades, work queues, accuracy and other related processes.

* Promote training participation and coach associates in following new and existing workflow processes. Deliver messages that promote change.

* Comply with and adheres to all regulatory compliance areas, policies and procedures and company “best practices”.

* Responsible for adhering to the quality, production, and turnaround standards associated with the department and/or assigned program.

* Other duties as assigned

PREFERRED EXPEREINCE – Home Infusion Coordination

* Ability to communicate effectively and professional with patients, physicians, and coworkers.

* Active listening, speaking, understanding, and writing English.

* Ability to make decisions, solve problems, and work independently with minimal supervision.

* Proven knowledge and complete utilization of processes, systems and techniques to ensure successful authorization.

* Proven ability to identify gaps and problems from review of documentation, determine lasting solutions, make effective decisions, and take necessary corrective action.

* Ability to effectively teach and demonstrate proper interactions with patients and prescribers in a manner that is easy to grasp and allows for interactive learning.

**Company Description**

**The Medicus Firm (TMF)**, a part of M3USA, is a national healthcare recruitment firm with a mission to be the market leader which is most respected for its Performance, People, and Partnerships. One of the largest physician recruitment companies in the US, TMF focuses on providing the most efficient and effective recruiting services to hospitals and healthcare employers nationwide with unmatched sophistication, consultation, and market insight. Due to its transparent and consultative approach, The Medicus Firm is a nine-time winner of the Best of Staffing Client Satisfaction award, presented by ClearlyRated. By providing a collaborative work environment with a competitive compensation model, TMF has successfully built an accomplished team that is the recipient of multiple awards for its culture.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for an **AI & Technology Enablement Specialist** with **The Medicus Firm**, an M3 company.

As part of the M3 family of companies, The Medicus Firm benefits from M3’s physician reach through millions of active physicians who regularly participate in market research, continuing education, clinical research, professional enrichment, etc.

 **Job Description**

The Medicus Firm (TMF) connects physicians and advanced practice providers with the healthcare organizations that need them. Our Operations team exists to make TMF’s recruiters faster, better informed, and easier for clients and candidates to work with — and this role sits at the center of that mission. You’ll turn AI and technology investments into everyday tools the team actually uses, while keeping the systems behind the business (CRM, ATS, sales operations) accurate and working.

What you’ll do:

* Lead discovery and evaluation calls with AI and technology vendors, documenting findings and driving go/no-go decisions
* Own integration of approved AI tools from kickoff through go-live, bridging leadership, IT, and vendors
* Design and deliver training tailored to how recruiters, sales, and marketing actually work
* Partner with team leads to build and roll out AI-supported workflows for sourcing, outreach, screening, and reporting
* Track adoption, gather feedback, refresh training, and retire tools that aren’t earning their keep
* Maintain an inventory of AI and technology tools, licenses, renewals, and owners
* Support sales leadership with pipeline reporting, CRM hygiene, and contract/proposal templates
* Identify sales ops tasks ripe for automation or AI assistance
* Define and maintain CRM/ATS data standards, run quality checks, and coach staff on data entry

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years in technology enablement, solutions, implementation, customer success, revenue operations, or sales operations
* Hands-on experience implementing or supporting a CRM or ATS (Bullhorn, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
* Proven track record rolling out AI tools or automation to non-technical teams
* Staffing, recruiting, physician recruitment, or healthcare technology experience a plus
* Strong facilitation skills — comfortable running a vendor call and a leadership discussion in the same day
* Ability to document workflows and write clear, plain-language guides
* Comfortable working with data: building reports, spotting quality issues, explaining what they mean

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

5276cb9841049000e14c.description:
**Job Title:** Senior Recruiter

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Location**: Remote

**Salary Range:** $90,000-$100,000 DOE

**Authorization Status**: Must be Authorized to Work in the U.S.

**Clearance Requirements:** None  
  
**About Aleto**

Aleto specializes in federal property management, space planning, and facility management. Aleto primarily supports federal government agencies to create realty solutions, provide facility and space planning support services, and enhance strategic communications.

We are looking to hire motivated people who are excited to grow with us. You'll have the potential to help improve processes and help identify solutions for our government, supporting the organizations that serve American citizens across the country. We offer the opportunity to work directly with clients to have a real impact on the day-to-day operations of federal agencies.

We are a growing company that stands firm on our core values: Accountability, Ingenuity, Reliability, Service, and Stewardship. This is what sets us apart from our competitors.

**Our Mission, Vision, and Purpose:**

* Aleto aspires to be the trusted advisor to senior executives for federal leasing and facilities operations decision-making.
* Aleto is committed to helping federal agencies improve their workspaces.
* Our purpose is to enhance workplaces with our innovations, while maintaining trust with dependable, responsible and high quality service.

We work hand-in-hand with our partners, from start to finish, to ensure we're identifying and delivering the best solutions based on their business needs.

We offer paid vacation, sick time, paid federal holidays, parental leave, full medical/dental/vision, and a 401(k).

Aleto is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

**What we are looking for**

Aleto Inc. is seeking to hire a Senior Recruiter to perform and own all duties related to full-cycle recruiting, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, scheduling, extending offers, hiring, and coordinating new employee onboarding, while also supporting the employee lifecycle and broader HR project and operational needs of the organization.

Responsible for building creative staffing approaches, maintaining customer-focused relationships, and providing reliable, proactive HR, marketing, and operational support that reflects Aleto's values of Accountability, Reliability, Ingenuity, Service, and Stewardship.

**Interview Process**

If you are selected for an interview, Aleto will contact you by email to arrange an interview via an online platform, such as Google Meets, or by telephone. The entire interview process can average around 3 weeks from the time you are initially contacted to interview. After all candidates are interviewed, Aleto will notify you of your application status.

If an offer is extended, the start date is determined based on factors such as availability and the amount of time it takes for the government's background clearance process (depending on the client).

Visit our website at www.aletosloutions.com to learn more about Aleto, Inc.

**Senior Recruiter - Essential Job Duties**

Duties include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Facilitate all phases of the recruitment process.
* Manage all new employee onboarding and current employee voluntary offboarding activities, including required communications, documentation, system updates, and completion of established checklists.
* Utilize the ATS to develop standardized recruiting workflows and update the system as needed.
* Collaborate with hiring managers to identify and draft detailed and accurate job descriptions and hiring criteria.
* Post, update, and promote job descriptions as necessary while maintaining and monitoring the organization’s advertising budget.
* Identify and implement efficient, exciting, and effective recruiting methods and strategies based on the available role, industry standards, and the needs of the organization.
* Proactively source and communicate with qualified job seekers using various job boards like LinkedIn and Indeed, and work with and through industry associations and employees to develop a network that would potentially deliver promising candidates.
* Screen applications/resumes and recommend qualified candidates to the next stage of the interview process.
* Schedule video virtual interviews and oversee the preparation of effective interview questions and other hiring and selection materials.
* Assist with the interview process, attend and conduct interviews with hiring managers and other stakeholders when necessary.
* Collaborate with the hiring manager and/or other human resource staff during the offer process, by identifying and recommending salary ranges, start dates, and other pertinent details.
* Contact candidate references, document response when available.
* Create and facilitate training sessions for managers within the organization related to interviewing and hiring best practices.
* Maintain accurate employee data and independently develop proficiency in HRIS functions, reporting, and analytics; prepare recurring and ad hoc workforce reports such as recruiting, turnover, and employee lifecycle metrics. Provide reports to the Executive Team on various Talent Acquisition data to include Time to Fill, Cost to Fill, etc.
* Develop and maintain a pool of potential future hires based on the anticipated staffing needs of a growing company.
* Assist with VET, AAP and EEOC reporting.
* Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and company policies.
* Attend and participate in job fairs and recruiting events.
* Facilitate new employee orientation and ensure presentations and supporting materials remain accurate, current, and aligned with the employee experience.
* Coordinate and continuously improve the new employee onboarding process, including maintaining checklists, standard operating procedures, email templates, forms, orientation materials, and related HRIS workflows.
* Provide flexible HR administrative and operational support as business needs evolve, recognizing that the position includes responsibilities beyond recruiting.
* Research routine questions using available documentation, system resources, training materials, and appropriate self-directed learning; bring forward proposed solutions and clearly identified support needs.
* Use available time productively to strengthen HR knowledge, learn systems and tools, identify needed work, and independently pursue improvements that support the HR team and organization.
* Regularly audit HR documents, forms, presentations, links, templates, and standard operating procedures; proactively correct outdated information and recommend process improvements.
* Take ownership of assigned employee communications, including drafting employee news articles and verifying information through available company systems and resources.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications/Capabilities/Software Knowledge**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Qualifications/Education/Experience:

* Associate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field required; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
* Minimum of five (5) years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Minimum of ten (10) years of experience providing high-level administrative or operational support to senior leaders.
* Experience recruiting within the federal contracting or government services industry is strongly preferred.
* Professional HR certifications such as SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR are highly desirable.

Technological Skills:

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365.
* Experience utilizing SharePoint or similar document management and collaboration platforms preferred.
* Minimum of three (5) years of experience working with an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) or comparable recruiting technology.
* Experience with JazzHR or similar recruiting platforms is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience working with Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS) and adapting to new HR technologies and software solutions.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to leverage technology, process documentation, and productivity tools to research issues, solve problems, streamline processes, and improve operational efficiency.
* Ability to learn new systems quickly and effectively utilize available resources to support recruiting, HR, and business objectives.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

* Ability to map interview questions to company values
* Experience with developing effective recruitment marketing strategies that attract and retain top talent.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, customer relationship management, and strong negotiation skills.
* Ability to create a positive first impression by explaining and emphasizing Aleto’s Mission, Vision, and Values.
* Excellent organizational ability to ensure the candidate database is maintained and candidates receive timely responses regarding their application status.
* Proactive and independent with the ability to take initiative.
* Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Familiarity with laws, regulations, and best practices applicable to hiring and recruitment.
* Working knowledge of employee onboarding, offboarding, HR records, employee communications, and routine HR administration.
* Demonstrated reliability, attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to manage multiple priorities with limited supervision.
* Resourceful self-starter who identifies needed work, independently learns systems and processes, and recommends practical improvements.
* Strong service orientation and commitment to maintaining accurate, timely, and professional employee and candidate experiences.

Other:

* Highest level of integrity managing confidential information

**Aleto’s Employee Expectations/Responsibilities**

* Compliance with all Aleto processes, standards, and guidelines including the utilization of the employee and intranet platforms to stay up to date on company news and events, submitting expense reports, providing monthly progress reports, etc.
* Participate in recurring 1:1 and performance development meetings with your Aleto team lead to discuss current job tasks, promote open dialog/feedback, recognize and celebrate wins, and review positive and purposeful approaches for meeting work-related and professional development goals.
* Attend team meetings, tri-annual company All-Hands Meetings, and other company-sponsored team-building events to foster and support Aleto's core values, vision, and culture.

**What We Offer: Benefits and Perks**

At Aleto, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable assets. We are proud to offer the following employee programs and benefits to enhance our employee’s well-being and total rewards package while practicing our core value of Stewardship.

**Pay Cycle**

Paydays are on the 10th and the 24th of the month.

* Payment is on an arrears basis (for example, time worked the 1st through 15th is paid on the 24th of that month; time worked the 16th through the last day of the month is paid on the 10th of the following month).

**Below is a list of comprehensive benefits offered to employees who work 30 hours or more each week:**

* *Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance:*

Aleto employees are offered single, single-plus-one-dependent, or family medical, vision, and dental insurance plans.

Aleto offers three medical plan options to employees. Aleto contributes $415 of the employee premium to the base medical plan and the option to “buy up” for the two additional plans.

Aleto contributes 75% of the employee premium for the visions and dental plans.

* *Pre-Tax Savings Accounts*

The option to enroll in an HSA or FSA depending on elected medical insurance coverage.

* *Disability Insurance:*

Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.

* *Life Insurance:*

Company-paid life insurance coverage.

* *Paid Time Off:*

Paid time off includes eleven federal holidays. Full-time employees accrue PTO at the rate of 5 hours per pay period for a total of three weeks per year. In addition, employees are provided with a separate bank of 40 hours of paid sick leave per year.

* *Retirement Plan:*

Aleto offers full-time employees a 401(k) qualified retirement plan with up to a 4% match with a minimum of a 5% employee contribution.

**Environment and Physical Conditions**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to have ambulatory skills sufficient to visit other locations; and the ability to remain in a stationary position at least 50% of the time, move inside and around an office, position themself to access items located in high or low areas, and transport items weighing up to 20 pounds across the office. Requires the constant operation of a computer and other office productivity machinery and the ability to observe details at a close range typically within a few feet of the observer. The employee interacts frequently with other workers, vendors, and clients and will communicate information and ideas so others will understand and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. The position consistently requires work to be completed in an office environment with artificial light and air.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

If you have questions or need additional assistance, please contact us at talent@aletoconsulting.com

**Position Summary**

The Internal Services Coordinator is a highly organized and detail-oriented individual contributor responsible for providing administrative, recruiting, training, compliance, and project support across the Internal Services Group. This position serves as a central resource supporting Human Resources, Transportation, Supply Chain, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE), Risk Management, and Executive Leadership.

  

The Internal Services Coordinator plays a key role in recruiting administration, learning and development program management, driver compliance reporting, organizational reporting, project coordination, and cross-functional administrative support. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, initiative, professionalism, the ability to manage competing priorities, and a commitment to confidentiality.

  

**Core Duties & Responsibilities**

**Recruiting Administration**

* Manage job postings across recruiting platforms including BambooHR, Indeed and other sourcing channels.
* Coordinate candidate communications, interview scheduling, and hiring manager follow up.
* Conduct applicant screening and initial qualification reviews.
* Maintain applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics.
* Support pre-employment activities including background checks, MVR reviews, and onboarding coordination.
* Oversee I-9 documentation, EEO reporting and metrix.
* Prepare recruitment reports and workforce planning updates.
* Assist with recruiting campaigns, hiring events, and talent pipeline initiatives.
* Manage new hire orientation scheduling and compliance.

**Learning & Development Administration**

* Manage the company's Learning & Development platform.
* Assign training programs and monitor completion status.
* Generate training compliance reports for leadership.
* Maintain employee learning records and certifications.
* Support development initiatives, leadership training programs, and company learning campaigns.
* Assist with administration of mandatory compliance training.

**Driver Qualification & Compliance Support**

* Coordinate and maintain Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring processes.
* Conduct biannual MVR reviews for applicable field personnel.

JOB POSTING

**Job Title: Coordinator, Business Development**
------------------------------------------------

Department: Business Development

Reports to: Assistant Director, Business Development

Who We Are:

For over 30 years, CAF America has been a leader in enabling cross-border giving validated charities and charitable projects across the world totaling more than $1 billion. We enable our donors to make strategic, cost-effective, and tax-advantaged gifts through our vetted network of more than 1.9 million charitable organizations in 135 countries, all while reducing the risk, reputation exposure, and administrative burden associated with cross-border giving.

At CAF America, we pride ourselves on creating a positive working environment and culture that values all team members’ experience and voices and represents the society we serve. We want to attract, retain, and develop the best of talent at all levels, and provide a leading and great place to work, where every voice matters.

Summary:

The Coordinator, Business Development plays a critical role in supporting day-to-day operations and service delivery for donor-advised funds and philanthropic accounts. Reporting to the Assistant Director, this role manages a portfolio of administrative activities across the fund lifecycle including contributions, validations, grant recommendations, and disbursements. The coordinator ensures smooth collaboration across internal departments, supports accurate recordkeeping and reporting, and serves as a key partner to Business Development Leads in delivering high-quality service to donors and charity partners.

This position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage workflows across multiple teams and systems. The coordinator will proactively identify and address operational bottlenecks, uphold data integrity and compliance standards, and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and client service experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities:

* Coordinate administrative activity for single gifts, new donor-advised funds, and grants, with a focus on accurate data entry, documentation, tracking, and timely completion.
* Support contributions, validations, onboarding requirements, grant recommendations, disbursement-cycle additions, and grant-processing activities by coordinating with internal departments and ensuring required information is complete and accurate.
* Track open tasks, deadlines, data updates, onboarding requirements, grant additions, and transaction pipelines, identifying missing information, bottlenecks, and outstanding items for follow-up. Partner closely with Relationship Managers to deliver seamless client service on assigned funds, ensuring smooth handoffs and coordination of donor requests.
* Help move donor inquiries, single-gift opportunities, new fund onboarding, and grant-processing workflows from initiation through completion with clear documentation and accurate status tracking.
* Provide administrative and operational support to the Business Development Specialist and broader Business Development team, including internal coordination, data tracking, task follow-up, and preparation for donor, advisor, and prospect engagement.
* Coordinate internal handoffs, information requests, and documentation so the Specialist and relationship leads can manage external communications and relationship-sensitive follow-up.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in CRM, grants management, finance, and related systems, ensuring consistent coding, status updates, and supporting documentation.
* Support data audits, pipeline reporting, disbursement-cycle tracking, and documentation for high volumes of donor opportunities, single gifts, grants, and new fund activity.
* Review contribution, grant, disbursement-cycle, onboarding, and donor-transaction documentation before and after processing to support accuracy, consistency, and compliance with internal standards.
* Prepare standard activity confirmations, onboarding materials, status updates, and follow-up communications using approved templates and verified system data.
* Respond to routine administrative inquiries as appropriate and escalate donor-facing, complex, or relationship-sensitive matters to the Business Development Specialist or appropriate relationship lead.
* Identify opportunities to improve tracking, documentation, audit readiness, grant-processing workflows, onboarding coordination, and administrative efficiency.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Must be eligible to work legally in the United States
* Associate's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. 2-4 years of experience in nonprofit operations, grants administration, finance or data operations, client service support, donor services, CRM/data management, or a related administrative support role.
* Strong organizational, critical-thinking, administrative coordination, and written communication skills.
* Highly detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to accuracy, follow-through, and responsive internal support.
* Comfortable working with high-volume, detail-heavy grant, contribution, and transaction data while maintaining accuracy under deadlines.
* Able to manage multiple priorities, follow established processes, and work collaboratively across teams.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and basic reporting or tracking tools.

  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily, with or without accommodation. If you require accommodation to perform these essential functions, please contact the Human Resources Department. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Your health and wellness are important to us. CAF America offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 100% paid premium for Employee Medical, Dental and Vision insurance along with a Health Savings Account (HSA), Life Insurance, Accidental Death and Dismemberment Insurance, Short- and Long-Term Disability, 401k program with up to 15% match, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and robust Time Off programs.

  

Annual Salary Range: $58,000 - $62,000

b2d7d8cc184739ab5a02.title: Contract Recruiter, Technical & Operations Hiring (Remote, 6-Month Contract)
b2d7d8cc184739ab5a02.description:
### **About the Opportunity**

Our client is a well-capitalized, global technology organization operating at the forefront of artificial intelligence, automation, and advanced infrastructure development.

As part of a major investment in next-generation AI capabilities, the company is building a portfolio of large-scale, mission-critical data center projects across Texas. These initiatives are designed to support high-performance computing, advanced analytics, and real-world AI applications.

The organization offers a fast-paced, high-performance environment that values operational excellence, disciplined execution, and the ability to scale complex infrastructure in support of long-term growth.

*Due to the nature of this project, additional details will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process.*

The ideal candidate brings strong agency-style instincts, exceptional direct sourcing skills, and the ability to find and engage talent without relying on automated sourcing platforms or inbound applicants. You will independently manage searches from hiring manager intake through verbal offer acceptance across frontline, technical, operational, professional, and leadership positions.

We are looking for a true talent hunter, someone who knows how to find people, build relationships, solve sourcing challenges, and deliver results through creativity, persistence, and sound judgment.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Full-Cycle Recruiting*

* Independently manage assigned requisitions from intake through verbal offer acceptance
* Partner with hiring managers to define requirements, candidate profiles, priorities, and timelines
* Build and execute targeted recruiting strategies across a diverse mix of roles
* Conduct thorough screens covering technical capability, experience, motivation, compensation, and fit
* Present qualified slates with clear assessments and recommendations
* Drive candidates through interviews and selection, keeping momentum and decisions moving
* Support offer development, negotiation, and closing
* Deliver consistent communication and a positive candidate experience throughout

*Direct Sourcing and Pipeline Development*

* Identify and engage active and passive talent through advanced Boolean, Google X-Ray, market mapping, networking, referrals, and direct outreach
* Apply traditional agency techniques to reach hard-to-find candidates
* Build pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs
* Source effectively with limited tools and technology resources
* Provide market intelligence on talent availability, compensation, and competitive hiring trends

*Hiring Manager Partnership*

* Serve as a trusted recruiting advisor to hiring managers and business leaders
* Set clear expectations on qualifications, timelines, interview process, and selection criteria
* Facilitate debriefs and support timely, evidence-based hiring decisions
* Communicate proactively on progress, challenges, and hiring risks
* Handle sensitive matters with professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality

*Recruiting Operations*

* Keep candidate and requisition data accurate and current in available systems
* Track sourcing activity, pipelines, interviews, offers, and outcomes
* Support weekly recruiting updates and pipeline reviews
* Identify ways to streamline process and improve hiring efficiency
* Represent the client’s culture and values professionally in every candidate interaction

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably including agency, executive search, or high-volume recruiting
* Proven success recruiting across frontline, technical, professional, and leadership roles
* Advanced Boolean search proficiency, demonstrated expertise or formal certification
* Track record of recruiting successfully with limited technology or infrastructure
* Strong agency-style skills: cold outreach, candidate identification, relationship building, and closing
* Ability to manage multiple requisitions and competing priorities independently
* Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and senior leaders
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong organization, urgency, accountability, and follow-through
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality around candidate, compensation, and business information

**Preferred Experience**

* Agency or executive search background with an emphasis on proactive talent identification
* Experience recruiting in technology, engineering, operations, construction, infrastructure, security, or related industries
* Experience balancing high-volume operational hiring with specialized professional searches
* Startup, entrepreneurial, or rapid-scale environment experience
* Prior contract recruiting supporting accelerated hiring initiatives
* Familiarity with ATS platforms, recruiting analytics, and pipeline reporting

**What Success Looks Like**  
Consistently delivering qualified pipelines, earning the trust of hiring managers, and helping the client hit its hiring priorities while maintaining a high bar for candidate quality and experience. The right person adapts quickly, produces results through resourcefulness and strong fundamentals, and represents the organization with professionalism, integrity, and discretion.

### **About Augmentis**

Augmentis is a specialized talent solutions firm focused on delivering high-impact professionals across Accounting, Finance, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations. We partner with organizations operating in complex, high-growth environments—supporting critical hiring initiatives with speed, precision, and a consultative approach.

**Text Message Consent & Privacy**  
As part of your application, you'll have the option to receive text updates about your status, screening, and scheduling. This is optional; it is not required to apply. See our Privacy Policy and SMS Terms & Conditions for details on how your information is used and protected.

c46f2a94cc7111e85ac9.title: Administrative Coordinator
c46f2a94cc7111e85ac9.description:
**About Blueprint**

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you'll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You'll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

**Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.**

**In This Role**

In this role, you will support the end-to-end management of business guest credentials for a large enterprise organization. You will serve as a primary point of contact for business guests, managers, administrators, and internal stakeholders, ensuring requests are handled efficiently and information remains accurate and up to date. Your responsibilities will include coordinating onboarding and offboarding, tracking credential renewals and end dates, responding to inquiries, and assisting with access and IT-related needs. You will also coordinate device requests and returns when needed and provide support for additional credential management activities. This remote role is well suited for an organized, detail-oriented professional who enjoys structured administrative work, clear communication, and keeping day-to-day operations running smoothly.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end business guest credential management process, including onboarding, offboarding, renewals, and credential end dates.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business guests, managers, administrators, and internal stakeholders regarding credential-related questions and requests.
* Monitor shared inboxes, respond to email inquiries, and ensure requests are triaged, tracked, and resolved in a timely manner.
* Maintain accurate business guest records, credential information, status updates, and tracking reports.
* Assist business guests with onboarding-related access issues and basic IT support needs, coordinating with appropriate support teams when necessary.
* Coordinate device requests, distribution logistics, and device returns while maintaining accurate records.
* Communicate updates, outstanding actions, and potential delays to relevant stakeholders to ensure visibility and consistent follow-through.
* Support additional credential management activities, administrative requests, and ad hoc operational tasks as business needs evolve.

**Required Qualifications**

* At least 2 years of experience in administrative support, business operations, coordination, or a related role.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage inquiries and coordinate effectively across multiple stakeholders.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring tasks, competing priorities, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate records, track requests, and follow established processes through completion.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining a consistent schedule and responsive communication.
* Reliable follow-through, a proactive approach to managing inboxes and requests, and the ability to identify items requiring additional attention.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting administrative operations within a large enterprise, corporate, or technology-focused organization.
* Experience coordinating employee, contractor, vendor, or business guest onboarding and offboarding.
* Familiarity with credential lifecycle management, access requests, account administration, or identity and access management processes.
* Experience managing shared inboxes, service requests, tracking logs, status reports, and stakeholder communications.
* Experience coordinating IT equipment requests, device distribution, returns, or inventory tracking.
* Experience using Excel and SharePoint to maintain records, manage documentation, and track operational activities.
* Experience supporting process-driven workflows that require accuracy, confidentiality, consistency, and minimal supervision.
* Relevant hands-on experience in administrative or business support; a degree is not required in place of applicable experience.

**Compensation**

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market.

The anticipated compensation range is $15 to $16 per hr. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final compensation and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate's qualifications.

**Benefits**

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Competitive paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Applicant Accommodations**

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

eb5bae560e17a935fa2f.title: Dispatcher
eb5bae560e17a935fa2f.description:
### **About Zūm:**

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (*Zūm CMX*™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – *Zūm CMX* is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 6,500 schools rely on *Zūm CMX*. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

**About the Role**

We're seeking an experienced Dispatcher to lead daily transportation operations and serve as the critical communication hub at our Philadelphia, PA location. This role encompasses the complete dispatch lifecycle—from daily route assignments and driver coordination to emergency response and real-time problem-solving. You'll ensure seamless service delivery by orchestrating drivers, vehicles, and routes while maintaining constant communication with school districts, families, and internal teams. You'll be the operational heartbeat of our transportation service, ensuring every student gets to school safely and on time, every single day.

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

You're the calm in the storm, the person who can juggle ten things at once and still remember to check in on that driver who's running five minutes behind. You thrive when the phones are ringing, routes need adjusting, and a bus just broke down on Main Street. You're a quick thinker who stays cool under pressure, makes smart decisions on the fly, and somehow manages to keep everyone informed and on track. You genuinely enjoy being the go-to problem solver, whether you're helping a new driver navigate an unfamiliar route, coordinating with the shop on a repair, or reassuring a parent that their child's bus is on the way. You've got great communication skills, a knack for prioritizing what matters most, and the kind of steady, reliable presence that makes people trust you to get things handled.

**Responsibilities**

**Daily Operations & Route Managemen**t

Direct and monitor daily assignments, schedule drivers, and assign vehicles to ensure full route coverage and on-time completion of all driver activitiesCommunicate all relevant details of driving assignments to drivers to ensure proper execution, and assist with routing directions and special service assignmentsCoordinate vehicle service and repairs with the Maintenance Manager to ensure uninterrupted service delivery

**Communication & Emergency Response**

Respond to emergency calls and coordinate the emergency response networkNotify stakeholders and location personnel of all route changes, emergencies, accidents, breakdowns, or service disruptions, and handle customer concerns promptly and professionallyProvide real-time operational support to drivers including assistance with traffic issues, routing questions, and emergency situations, escalating unresolved issues appropriatelyCompliance &

**Administrative Operations**

Maintain route documentation and records including contracts, customer information, route changes, maps, vehicle assignments, and driver details to ensure accuracy and compliance with district and state requirementsEnsure strict adherence to dispatch standard operating procedures and recommend disciplinary action for policy violations in coordination with managementTrack and document operational activities, incidents, and communications for reporting purposes while partnering with Location Manager and Safety Manager on compliance objectives

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

High school diploma or equivalentProficiency with Microsoft or G Suite applications (Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.)

Experience in high-pressure, time-sensitive operations (e.g., transportation, logistics, field services, customer service, hospitality, or similar fast-paced environments)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Background in a leadership, supervisory, or management capacity within fast-paced operational environmentsPrevious school busing or transportation experience, either as a driver or dispatcher is a plus

Knowledge of state DOT/DMV safety rules and company compliance expectations

Excellent oral and written communication skills with strong interpersonal abilities

Experience working in a union environment

Comprehensive knowledge of the local area, including traffic patterns, road restrictions, neighborhoods, and geography of the school district is highly desirable

Strong organizational, prioritization, and time management skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, coordinate scheduling and task assignments, maintain accurate records and filing systems, and track assets and inventory

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity, or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more.

*Zūm Services, Inc. and all its subsidiaries provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools, such as Lever, Fountain, Factory Fix, Metaview, Gem, Claude, to support parts of the hiring process, including reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on applicant’s provided data or publicly available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us at legal-compliance@ridezum.com.

6452743483502d03dc84.title: Director, Merchant Experience - Strategy & Operations
6452743483502d03dc84.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

On the Merchant Strategy & Operations team, our mission is to have best-in-class restaurant selection for Consumers and build products and services for our Merchants to grow their businesses profitably on DoorDash. We work on problems ranging from acquiring and onboarding new merchants to building a positive experience and solving pain points for existing merchants, to growing their sales through new products and services.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Merchant Strategy & Operations Director at DoorDash, you will lead the support experience for our merchants, owning both the strategy & execution of how we serve them once they're live on the platform. You'll be responsible for transforming support into a tech-first, scalable, and seamless experience that drives merchant satisfaction, retention & loyalty.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Strategize** – Build the strategy for helping merchants succeed once they're live on DoorDash by providing fast and seamless solutions when merchants face issues, minimizing operational friction
* **Experiment, Analyze and Implement** – Use data-driven decision-making and sound business judgment to drive go-to-market & execution for new initiatives to help merchants have the best experience on Doordash
* **Influence** – Work cross-functionally with our product, operations, marketing, sales, finance, and analytics teams to land key initiatives

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have a Bachelor's degree or higher
* You bring 10+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, operations, banking, technology, with time spent leading transformation in fast-paced or complex environments
* You have experience managing teams and driving large-scale, cross-functional initiatives
* You have **a bias for action**, are energized by ambiguity, and take ownership from start to finish
* You're naturally **curious** – You always look for ways to innovate and improve
* You're a **problem solver** – You approach problems from first principles and thoughtfully challenge the status quo
* You're **analytical** – You rely on data to guide decisions, and are comfortable pulling your own data in SQL or modeling in Excel.
* You're **persuasive and a relationship-builder** – You communicate clearly and effectively, adapting your style to collaborate and build alignment across teams and levels.

We expect this position to be filled by 12/16/2026

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

fe6fa5a11433df0581e8.title: Event Logistics Coordinator (14 hours/month)
fe6fa5a11433df0581e8.description:
**Position Overview**

The Writing Barn is seeking an Event Logistics Coordinator to serve as our back-up Technical Assistant (TA) for live virtual events.

This role is about **14 hours a month,** but it's worth noting that many of our now full-time staff started in similar part-time positions, and TWB has a strong culture of expanding team members' roles and hiring from within as we grow.

We have multiple online events a month and want to avoid scrambling if/when a team member has a last-minute scheduling conflict. This person would step in to manage live virtual events when our main TA staff is unavailable.

We have moderator instructions, but we can't possibly anticipate every potential issue, so we need someone who can think on their feet and use their best judgment to problem-solve on the fly.

Key Responsibilities

**Live Event Management & Technical Support**

* Open and manage Zoom or Google Meet rooms for live virtual events.
* Manage Zoom and Google Meet settings to ensure sessions run smoothly.
* Make sure sessions are being recorded.
* Admit participants and manage access to virtual events.
* Assist guest speakers with screen sharing and other technical needs.
* Manage chat and provide support to participants during live sessions.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and problem-solve on the fly.
* Prioritize competing requests and manage multiple needs when participants or speakers require assistance at the same time.
* Follow moderator instructions while using good judgment to address unexpected situations.

**Administrative Support**

Since this is an "on-call" position, but we want your schedule to be predictable, the hours would be set. In the event that our main TA staff IS available, you would focus on admin projects during that time instead.

Those projects might include:

* Data entry
* Online research
* Other administrative tasks, nothing too technical

Schedule & Availability

The person in this role would need to have online availability during the following hours:

* **Monday evenings:** 5:45 p.m. to 7:45 p.m. CT
* **Two Saturdays each month (typically third and fourth):** 9:45 a.m. to 11:45 a.m. CT

We hope to add more hours as we expand our events schedule.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal person is:

* Online and reachable during the required hours.
* Comfortable running a Zoom or Google Meet room or online event, including managing platform settings.
* Good with on-the-spot problem-solving.
* Able to prioritize competing requests and respond effectively when multiple people need assistance at once during a live event.
* Detail-oriented with strong admin skills.
* Comfortable thinking on their feet and using their best judgment to handle unexpected situations.
* Interested in learning about kidlit publishing!

**About Our Events**

Our events all center on kidlit publishing, and our guest speakers are usually agents, editors, or authors who work in the industry and are sharing their expertise with emerging writers.

**Growth Opportunities**

Many of our now full-time staff started in similar part-time positions, and TWB has a strong culture of expanding team members' roles and hiring from within as we grow.

We hope to add more hours to this position as we expand our events schedule.

Job Types: Part-time, Contract

Pay: $20.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Application Question(s):

* Record a 2-minute video briefly introducing yourself to help us get to know you and share why you think you’d be a great fit. Don’t stress about perfection. Share the link to view your video here.

Work Location: Remote

72a75d16a82473627f4b.title: Social Media Content Coordinator (PT) - Remote
72a75d16a82473627f4b.description:
**About:**

**Are you always ahead of the latest social media trends and passionate about brand storytelling? At Vanguard College Prep, we are seeking a detail-oriented Social Media Content Coordinator to manage and elevate our digital presence across all social channels. In this role, you will plan, create, and schedule daily engaging content across all our social channels. You will craft eye-catching visual and video assets, manage community interactions, and analyze post performance to drive measurable growth and engagement while fostering meaningful connections with our online community.**

**Compensation:**

* Starting Compensation: **$16.00 – $19.00** depending on education, experience, and skill.
  + Work from home, occasional commute
  + Flexible Schedule
  + Career growth opportunities

**What You'll Do:**

* ### **Content Creation & Curation**

* **Short-Form Video Production:** Script, film, and edit vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts using mobile editors like CapCut or desktop tools like Adobe Premiere Pro.
* **Graphic & Visual Asset Design:** Create static graphics, carousel posts, infographics, and story assets using Canva, Photoshop, or Illustrator.
* **Copywriting:** Draft engaging captions, call-to-actions (CTAs), video scripts, and post copy tailored to each platform's distinct tone and audience.
* **Brand Voice Maintenance:** Ensure all visual design choices, messaging, and tone strictly follow established brand guidelines.

* ### **Planning & Scheduling**

* **Editorial Calendar Management:** Build and maintain weekly/monthly content calendars aligned with product launches, marketing campaigns, and seasonal events.
* **Content Scheduling:** Upload and schedule posts across platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Youtube) using scheduling platforms
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Collaborate with internal teams as needed to gather assets and information for upcoming posts.

* ### **Community Management**

* **Active Daily Engagement:** Monitor active feeds and inbox messages daily to respond to comments, direct messages (DMs), and mentions.
* **UGC Curation:** Identify user-generated content (UGC), engage with creators, and coordinate permissions to repurpose high-performing posts that apply to our brand.
* **Customer Support Routing:** Flag customer complaints, technical issues, or public relations risks appearing on social channels and route them to support or leadership teams.

* ### **Analytics & Reporting**

* **Analytics & Reporting:** Track key performance indicators (KPIs)—reach, impressions, engagement rates, follower growth, click-throughs, and conversions—and compile regular performance reports with actionable insights to optimize strategy.
* **Trend Identification:** Research viral audio clips, trending video formats, and emerging platform features to pitch timely content opportunities.
* **Competitor & Industry Monitoring:** Benchmark channel performance against industry trends and key industry competitors to refine publishing schedules and post styles.

### **Requirements:**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree or higher
* **Work Experience:** A minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts, producing digital content, and/or coordinating organic social campaigns for a brand, business, or agency.
* **Communication Skills:** Ability to write clear, engaging post copy, short hooks, and clear calls-to-action (CTAs) that match a brand's specific voice and tone.
* **Analytical Skills:** Ability to read social media platform insights (engagement rate, reach, impressions, click-throughs) and turn metrics into actionable content adjustments.
* **Work Setup:** Reliable high-speed internet connection and a professional, distraction-free workspace suitable for video content production
* **Tech Proficiency:** Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, social media platforms for posting content, and video editing platforms such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop etc.

### **The ideal candidate will also possess:**

* The ability to work both independently and in a team environment
* Excellent content creation and editing skills
* Ability to create growth in the number of followers across all platforms
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities to be able to meet content posting goals and create content when viral trends emerge
* Manage multiple deadlines and content pipelines simultaneously
* Experience with meeting social media related goals set by organizations
* Ability to optimize post captions, alt text, and video metadata for social search engines using strategic keywords.

**Why Work With Us?**

* **Meaningful Impact:** You will be able to provide the opportunity for more students to be able to use our services through social media reach
* **Career Growth:** Opportunities for leadership and long-term career growth
* **Elite Peer Network:** Join a tight-knit team that shares resources, celebrates wins, and supports each other through ongoing professional development and mentorship. Quickly-growing start-up environment that emphasizes creativity, collaboration, and mentorship.
* **Fully Remote Flexibility:** Enjoy the autonomy of working from home with regular team collaboration and support.

**About Us:**

601851307ed236ed3b1b.description:
**We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this****link****directly.**

  

**Who we are**

Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.

Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.

At **Emphasys PHA**, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Technical Operations Manager, we are looking for a **Technical Support Specialist**. As our new Technical Support Specialist you will be part of a team providing front-line technical expertise across our hosted environments, taking ownership of escalated issues related to Azure Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), MSIX App Streaming, SQL performance, and application deployment pipelines. You will work closely with our Infrastructure, Development, and Product teams to troubleshoot, document, and improve the reliability, performance and security of our technical operations.

*This is a full-time, fully remote position within the US.*

**What’s in it for you**

*Breadth and depth.* You will deepen your expertise in modern cloud platforms and deployment tools while building hands-on experience across a wide range of technologies—from virtual desktops and SQL databases to application deployment pipelines. Your work will support essential systems used by government clients to manage funding, determine program eligibility, and allocate resources within their communities.

*A collaborative culture.* You will join a close-knit support team trusted with high-priority issues and critical environments. While much of your time will be spent on ticket resolution, your input on optimization, documentation, and internal tooling will be valued.

*Career growth.* You will receive direct mentorship from seasoned leaders and collaborate with a skilled team where teaching is prioritized. Whether you want to grow your role on this team, another area of Emphasys, or as part of the larger Aquila team, you will be supported in your career development.

**As our new Technical Support Specialist, you will:**

* **Support Azure-hosted environments.** You will provide tier 1 and 2 support across Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), SQL databases, MSIX app streaming, and related Microsoft services. You will support cloud migrations and environment upgrades by performing environment testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.
* **Resolve technical issues.** You will respond to a range of tickets, including password resets, printing issues, environment access, SQL errors, and plug-in failures. You will troubleshoot, resolve, and communicate problems based on priority, escalating when necessary.
* **Manage and optimize deployments.** You will assist with managing CI/CD pipelines, primarily using Octopus Deploy, and help automate processes for application updates and patches.
* **Work across server technologies.** You will interact with IIS, Active Directory, File Servers, Domain Controllers, and API Servers to support performance, access, and integrations. You will assist with database backups, restores, and disaster recovery to ensure continuity and performance.
* **Document, track, and improve.** You will log incident reports, resolution steps, and system notes in the internal ticketing system. You will identify opportunities to improve documentation, streamline support tasks, and share knowledge with peers.

**You bring:**

* **The customer service focus.** You have professional, adaptable communication skills and can explain technical issues clearly to a range of non-technical stakeholders. You are patient and maintain a professional, empathetic tone when handling support requests. You document resolutions thoroughly and thrive in a role that balances independence with collaboration in a fast-paced environment.
* **The experience.** You have worked in a technical support or systems role, with knowledge of Azure Virtual Desktop, SQL troubleshooting, and virtual application delivery. You have used CI/CD tools such as Octopus Deploy or similar and understand their function in deployment pipelines.
* **The analytical mindset.** You are confident analyzing logs, tracing issues across interconnected systems, and solving technical problems with urgency and creativity. You balance support tickets with deeper troubleshooting and proactive monitoring.

**Join us.**

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

**Apply now.**

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

* A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor will be scheduled to discuss your interest in the role and share your relevant experience.
* A virtual technical interview with the Technical Operations Manager and the Director of Development. This will be an opportunity for you to ask further questions about the role and team.
* A final virtual interview with the CEO for you to share more about your interest in the role and team as well as ask any questions around the company trajectory and culture.

Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.
