67a2a065708a15584ae0.description:
Job Description
  
  
It is critical that consistent, accurate, high-quality data is generated and maintained from clinical trials conducted worldwide. In collaboration with the Clinical Quality Operations Lead (CQOL) and Head of CQO, the CQOM is responsible for the execution of clinical quality oversight activities within an assigned trial. This includes proactive quality management, risk-based quality oversight, and clinical trial inspection management activities.
  
  
The CQOM will provide clinical quality operations support to Trial Teams (TTs) to proactively embed quality into sponsored trials, ensure robust supplier oversight, and address critical quality issues as needed.
  
The incumbent will assist with the overall strategy for maintaining ongoing inspection readiness, as well as preparing for, managing, and following up on regulatory inspections.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities:**  
Trial Team, Research Portfolio and Enterprise Support
  
  

* Independently support assigned Trial Teams (TT) and drive implementation of Quality by Design.
* Act as a Process Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Clinical Quality Operations, providing guidance on quality processes, standards, and regulatory requirements to TTs.
* Support identification, investigation, escalation, and resolution of study-level quality issues including Significant Quality Issues (SQIs) and Serious Breaches (SBs).
* Support Trial Teams in assessing trial health and conducting quality reviews, as needed.
* Lead Inspection Hypercare Teams (IHT) with the aim of ensuring that, at all stages, the Trial Team (TT) maintains ongoing inspection readiness.

Regulatory GCP Inspections & Research and Development Quality Assurance Audits
  

* Provide oversight for operational management of sponsor inspections (e.g., act as Control Room Lead or Control Room Support).
* Act as Inspection Lead for site inspections.
* Conduct pre-inspection visit (PIV) for impending site inspections.
* Author key inspection communications (e.g., daily summaries, inspection outcomes, and issue escalations).
* Coordinate the inspection response process managing the root cause analysis, Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) and associated regulatory commitments to completion, ensuring that key inspection documentation is maintained at all times.
* Support Quality Assurance audits (i.e., Study Level Audits) providing support to TT before, during and after audit, including coordinating root cause analysis for any applicable observations, development of responses, CAPA management and tracking.

Clinical Quality Risk Management
  

* Collaborate with the Clinical Quality Risk Manager (CQRM) to operationalize quality risk management during trial conduct.
* Provide critical insights from study level audits, inspections, and quality issues and support identification of actionable resolution pathways for quality signals that emerge during trial conduct.

Service Provider Quality Oversight
  

* Serve as the primary clinical quality Point of Contact (POC) for assigned key service providers (e.g., tier 1 and tier 2 service providers).
* Responsible for the strategic development and management of service provider clinical quality agreements.

Mergers & Acquisitions
  

* Support quality-related mergers and acquisitions activities, as required, to ensure comprehensive knowledge transfer, risk management, and inspection readiness.

CQO Infrastructure, Process Innovation & Special Projects
  

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CQO infrastructure and process innovation.
* Support and lead special projects and strategic assignments within CQO as assigned by CQOL.

AI Efficiency & Optimization
  

* Proactively identify and apply AI-driven approaches to improve operational efficiency and decision-making within CQO.
* Work with data and analytics to monitor performance and drive continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience
  
  
Education
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree or equivalent in a health care or scientific area.

Experience
  
  

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry and/or clinical research.
* Robust knowledge of quality management and clinical trial operations.
* Comprehensive knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), ICH GCP guidelines, and worldwide Regulatory Health Authority requirements.
* Advanced experience in independent root cause analysis (RCA), CAPA development and effectiveness management, and service provider quality oversight.

Skills
  

* Superior oral and written communication skills in an international, matrixed environment.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams of business and clinical professionals.
* Able to act urgently and decisively on worldwide health authority inspection matters.
* Ability to analyze, interpret, and solve complex quality and compliance issues.

. Ability to think strategically and objectively with digital savvy (awareness of AI and machine learning tools)

0627af0554033f3dc42b.description:
**Description**

**Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000**

**About Designs for Health**  
Designs for Health is a trusted leader in the nutraceutical industry, known for delivering high-quality, research-driven nutritional products that support better health outcomes. For more than 30 years, we have combined scientific integrity, innovation, and a strong commitment to quality to earn the confidence of practitioners and customers alike.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Senior CRM Marketing Operations Analyst to serve as the functional owner and power user for Marketing's use of HubSpot. This remote role combines CRM operations, marketing analytics, and email and SMS execution to support business-to-business (B2B), patient-focused business-to-consumer (B2C), and direct-to-consumer (DTC) channels.

The analyst owns Marketing-facing HubSpot processes, workflows, audiences, dashboards, campaign operations, and user enablement while partnering with Brand Leads, copywriters, Creative, Sales, IT, and other business teams. The role collaborates with the Senior CRM Sales Operations Analyst on shared customer and account data, lifecycle definitions, lead handoffs, integrations, and cross-functional reporting. The role also connects sales outcomes with customer insights while providing analysis, segmentation, and measurement support to campaign and lifecycle strategy owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional owner, senior power user, and subject matter expert for Marketing's use of HubSpot, including marketing processes, properties, lists, workflows, reports, dashboards, documentation, and usage standards.
* Analyze CRM, campaign, customer, and marketing-engagement data across B2B, patient-focused B2C, and DTC channels to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable insights.
* Build and maintain Marketing-facing HubSpot reports, dashboards, and performance summaries for Brand, Marketing, Customer Service, and leadership stakeholders; collaborate with the Sales CRM counterpart on shared funnel and revenue reporting.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads to define and maintain the strategic email and SMS content calendar, campaign schedule, automated flows, and related operational requirements.
* Coordinate with Brand Leads, copywriters, and Creative partners to move email and SMS content through development and ensure required copy, creative assets, audience criteria, and campaign details are ready for execution.
* Build, schedule, quality-check, and execute email and SMS campaigns and automated flows in HubSpot and connected tools, ensuring accurate audiences, links, timing, and tracking.
* Measure email and SMS performance, audience engagement, lead quality, conversion activity, and customer lifecycle outcomes and translate results into actionable recommendations.
* Develop and refine customer segments, targeting logic, campaign lists, suppression criteria, and audience-performance analysis in partnership with Brand Leads and other marketing stakeholders.
* Maintain and improve the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of Marketing-owned CRM data, including audience, consent, campaign, engagement, and marketing-touchpoint information; coordinate changes to shared contact and company data with the Sales CRM counterpart.
* Own Marketing's business requirements and operational support for HubSpot integrations with marketing automation, business intelligence, and other connected systems; coordinate shared integrations and data flows with the Sales CRM counterpart, IT, Data, and system owners.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Marketing-facing CRM data discrepancies, workflow issues, integration errors, and reporting inconsistencies; partner with the Sales CRM counterpart and technical owners when issues affect shared data or processes.
* Establish and improve governance for Marketing-owned HubSpot processes, including audience and consent standards, naming conventions, campaign tracking, workflow documentation, and marketing data quality; jointly maintain shared lifecycle and handoff definitions with Sales.
* Provide HubSpot guidance, training, and documentation for Marketing users that promote adoption, consistent campaign practices, data discipline, and reliable decision-making.

0bd5c97db418a5ba0665.description:
***Candidates residing within 50 miles of our office will be expected to work onsite Tuesday through Thursday as part of a hybrid schedule. Candidates residing outside of the 50-mile radius will be eligible for a remote position. If remote, this******position would require travel to the Headquarters location (Lansdale, PA) for onboarding and training during the first week.*** ***Please do not apply unless you are located on EST and are able to travel to Headquarters during the first week of employment.***

**About Keystone Technologies:**

Founded in 1945, Keystone Technologies is a third-generation, family-owned business headquartered in the Greater Philadelphia area. A national leader in the commercial and industrial lighting industry, Keystone reaches customers across the U.S. with its mission of "Light Made Easy."

**Who We Are:**

We’re not your typical lighting company — and we like it that way. At Keystone, we move fast, think big, and challenge the status quo to deliver on our promise of Light Made Easy®. Our team thrives on new ideas, supports one another, aims high, works hard, and laughs often. And we always put people first — whether that’s our customers, partners, or each other. If you’re passionate about growing, collaborating, and making a difference, you’ll feel right at home here.

**Keystone's core values:**

* **Wow Customers:** Every interaction is an opportunity to show how much we care and appreciate all our customers, internal and external, so we create unique experiences that go above and beyond their expectations.
* **Grow Passionately:** We embrace growth through creativity, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn. Our work isn’t just about achieving more; it’s about evolving personally and professionally, transforming at every opportunity.
* **Do Right:** It’s not just good ethics to do the right thing; it’s good business. We uphold the highest integrity, and we do the right thing even when it’s hard. Why? Because trust is our most important currency.
* **Value People:** We come from a range of backgrounds, affiliations, and experiences. We honor everybody’s story and build lifelong relationships, whether with colleagues, customers, or partners, because to reach our fullest potential means empowering people to thrive.
* **Challenge Convention:** We refuse to blindly accept the status quo. With agility, courage, and tenacity, we continuously improve — asking tough questions, looking beyond surfaces, and not stopping to rest on our accomplishments.

**What we offer:**

Our benefits include medical, dental, vision, voluntary life insurance, employer-paid group life insurance, short-term disability, a 401k plan with company match, paid time off, and philanthropic opportunities.

**The Opportunity:**

The Inside Sales Associate supports the Sales Team by managing quote opportunities, responding to customer inquiries, and fostering strong customer relationships. The ideal candidate possesses lighting industry experience and product knowledge, enabling them to provide accurate product recommendations, identify equivalent solutions, cross-reference competitive manufacturers' part numbers, and deliver exceptional support to customers and sales representatives.

**Your Impact:**

* Analyze customer sales data to identify sales trends and opportunities with management
* Collaborate with the Sales Support Specialist, Territory Managers, and the Director of Sales Operations to monitor inventory levels, validate material allocation, and proactively support future project demands and order fulfillment
* Cross-reference lighting manufacturers' part numbers to Keystone products, ensuring accurate specification matching, competitive replacements, and effective support for customers, distributors, and sales teams
* Create and manage opportunities in the CRM
* Maintain project visibility through management and reporting tools (Excel & CRM) to track status, timelines, and on-time delivery
* Oversee pipeline opportunities to ensure they are closed properly
* Receive and process customer purchase orders, allocating material appropriately while verifying inventory accuracy
* Build rapport and develop long-term relationships with customers to drive product demand
* Assist the team in processing time-sensitive purchase orders
* Other duties as assigned

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor's in business administration or related field preferred

* 1-2 years of sales experience in similar inside sales role

* Lighting industry experience and product knowledge required
* The ability to perform in a fast paced, time-sensitive work environment
* Possess outstanding customer service skills with attention to rapid responses, clarity in communications and a strong drive to exceed customer expectations
* Demonstrate exceptional organizational skills and a keen attention to detail
* Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficient in Microsoft Word & Excel
* Experience using CRM and Prophet 21 preferred but not required
* Uphold and implement Keystone’s Core Values, consistently aligning actions and decisions that reflect the core principles

*Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.*

4e3e3432445792c10085.title: Senior Associate, Account Manager
4e3e3432445792c10085.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Account Manager to join our team. The Account Manager will be responsible for retaining our top ARR clients & pooled plans and providing exceptional service to ensure client satisfaction and loyalty. Successful candidates will be responsible for supporting incoming employer plan inquiries, change orders, proactive outreaches, ongoing client reviews, and supporting multiple cross-functional teams across the organization. In addition, the Account Manager will have the flexibility to jump into other service teams and provide coverage and support as needed.

Our mission-driven service teams are often the first point of contact for customers, so we are interested in hiring individuals with a passion for providing memorable client experiences with the ability to make quick and accurate decisions. As a Vestweller, you are a dynamic individual who will work cross-functionally across teams to communicate and facilitate resolutions for any client satisfaction issues.

**What Will You Be Doing?**

As a Senior Associate, Employer Services Account Manager, you will act as a strategic, independent contributor responsible for managing and growing high-value employer client relationships. This is role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and autonomy to resolve complex plan and service issues. You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless, high-quality service experience.  
  
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

* **Client Relationship Management:** Independently manage and retain relationships with top ARR clients and pooled plans across Vestwell platforms, addressing post-onboarding needs such as plan design changes, year-end testing, education, and ongoing inquiries.
* **Strategic Advisory:** Work closely with clients to understand business goals and challenges, identifying opportunities to introduce additional Vestwell products and solutions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with internal teams—including Product, Operations, and Legal & Compliance—to resolve complex client issues, escalate when appropriate, and ensure client needs are met efficiently.
* **Proactive Outreach & Service Optimization:** Conduct proactive outreach to identify service gaps, platform opportunities, and relay the voice of the client to internal stakeholders.
* **Process & Playbook Development:** Design and document account management processes, playbooks, and resources to improve operational efficiency and support team growth.
* **Problem Solving & Escalation Management:** Handle escalated complaints, troubleshoot complex issues, recommend solutions, and coordinate with Legal and Compliance when necessary.
* **Client Communication & Trust-Building:** Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound client inquiries, communicating clearly, professionally, and empathetically to foster long-term relationships.
* **Documentation & Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of client interactions, service tickets, and account updates in internal systems to ensure transparency, continuity, and audit readiness.
* **Service Level Adherence & Workload Management:** Prioritize and manage workload effectively, meeting client-facing and internal Service Level expectations while exercising independent judgment.

**Requirements**

The Necessities:

* College degree and/or equivalent customer service experience
* 2-4 years of retirement industry experience, preferred
* Team mentality and the ability to multitask while attending to a high volume of incoming inquiries
* Strong time management and organizational skills to ensure the timeliness of all proactive and reactive communications
* Strong commitment to superior customer service
* Positive and proactive attitude
* Proficiency is required with Excel/Google Sheets, Word/Google Docs, Adobe Acrobat, and browsing network directories as we are a paperless office
* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy, proficient with numbers and basic calculations

  

This role will be based in either the New York City, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation. For exceptional candidates, we're open to hiring this role fully remote.  
  
The expected base salary range for this position is $60K - $80K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

  

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

*Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

5de3302bfaa1ce7926c6.title: Patient Access Liaison II - MBH South Phila.
5de3302bfaa1ce7926c6.description:
**Malvern Behavioral Health** is seeking a full-time **Patient Access Liaison II** to work at our acute inpatient behavioral health facility located at 1930 S Broad Street, Philadelphia PA 19145. The Patient Access Liaison II is a full-time position that reports up through our Finance department. The position offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefit package!

The Patient Access Liaison II is responsible to research/verify, patient healthcare coverage and benefits, along with payer requirements for reimbursement. This individual will handle all insurance verification by using the insurance portals as needed. Such as Promise (EVS), NaviNet, Availity and PEAR Portals. Will be responsible for calling the insurance company and obtaining the most recent benefit details, obtaining information regarding authorization and claim submission. They will have conversations with patients regarding their insurance coverage and benefit details along with collecting any Out-of-Pocket balances. They will be responsible for updating the billing system and ensuring all insurance verification documentation is attached to the individual’s account. They will work closely with multiple departments such as Admissions, Utilization Management; and Patient Accounting.

**Summary of Essential Position Functions:**

* Extensive time of communication via phone with patients/responsible parties, Insurance providers and/or managed care companies.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of patient information following the HIPPA guidelines.
* Accurate data entry of insurance/benefit and payer requirement information into computer system
* Provides excellent customer service to patients and families.
* Verifies insurance benefits to make sure plans are active and has no termination date showing in the immediate future, as well as verify any financial obligations such as deductibles, co-insurance, and co-pays that the patient would be responsible for.
* Communicates with supervisor on admissions that need payment plans for admissions.
* Calculate patient responsibility and explain benefit details to patients.
* Clearly explain estimated out of pocket responsibilities. Insurance coverage limits and policy benefits directly to patients or guarantors.
* Upfront collections will be expected. You will be responsible for requesting and accepting payments (estimated balances) via credit card or check.
* Concisely, and accurately document all information on the account and scan documents into the patients’ account.
* If patient is a prior patient, check billing system for prior balances outstanding. Explain prior balances to patients and assist in setting up a payment plan for prior patient activity balances.
* Assist the admission team by obtaining all pertinent information along with having admission documentation signed as needed.

**Benefits Offered for the Patient Access Liaison II position include: Medical, Dental, Vision coverage. A 401K offering with a company match! Free life insurance, free long term disability policy and paid time off!**

* Participates in continuing education (in- services & other training) to achieve professional growth.
* Perform other duties assigned to support Malvern Health’s vision and values.

**Qualifications:** To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. This position requires individuals that are client focused; team oriented; great interpersonal and communication skills; flexible to sudden changes in workload, emergency or staffing; dependable; problem solving skills; focused on compliance and performance quality. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Education and/or Experience:** High school diploma or equivalent required, bachelor’s degree preferred. Knowledge of addictive diseases preferred. Healthcare, Admissions, Insurance experience a plus.

**Technical/Computer Skills:** MS Office, billing software, telephone, and other office equipment.

**Work Environment and Hazards:** No hazardous conditions. Weather protected.

5d078fcafe18d2d74f26.title: Service Operations Coordinator – Scheduling, Dispatch & Administration
5d078fcafe18d2d74f26.description:
Mast RoofingConstruction in Oley, PA is seeking a full-time Service Operations Coordinator to keep our phones, appointment schedules, dispatch activities, and service administration running accurately and efficiently. This is a Client Care Representative position with substantial responsibility for coordinating the work behind every client interaction and helping turn incoming opportunities into completed, profitable work.

Answering a high volume of incoming calls is a central part of this role. Success also requires active thinking, independent judgment, and timely decisions. You will move between live calls, scheduling changes, technician needs, payments, and detailed administrative work throughout the day. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, anticipates problems, and follows through without waiting for repeated direction.

Annual earning potential is $45,000-$65,000, with a starting base of $22/hour+, DOE (depending on experience), plus performance incentives and bonus opportunities. Benefits include personalized training, paid holidays including your birthday, paid time off (PTO), medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, and an IRA retirement plan with a 100% company match up to 3%.

Are you quick-thinking, highly organized, and accurate under pressure? Can you listen closely, ask the right questions, and enter information directly into a computer system while keeping a conversation moving? If you enjoy solving scheduling problems, managing competing priorities, and taking ownership of results, we would like to meet you.

**ABOUT MAST ROOFINGCONSTRUCTION**

We are a faith-based, family-run, full-service residential and light commercial roofing and construction company. For over 28 years, we have built our reputation by caring for our clients and delivering quality workmanship through expert training, technology, and industry experience.  
Our mission is simple: To honor God by serving those around us with excellence. Our Core Values - W.I.S.E. - guide how we work: Work Hard, With Integrity, Serving Others, and With Excellence. We value our employees and their families and encourage personal growth, skill development, and a positive, professional culture of ownership and accountability.

**A DAY IN THE LIFE OF A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

You help set the pace for the day. You answer calls, identify client needs, book appointments, and keep the CRM current as conversations happen. You coordinate with sales and production, adjust schedules as priorities change, and help technicians arrive prepared. Between calls, you prepare production folders, process payments, track appointment outcomes, and make sure the next person has the information needed to do the job well.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Handle a high volume of incoming calls with professionalism, urgency, and accuracy. Work toward answering 98% of calls by the third ring and use a headset throughout the work shift to support efficient call handling.
* Maintain a minimum 80% booking ratio by using approved scripts, asking effective questions, explaining the value of our services, and addressing objections confidently and respectfully.
* Listen and type client information directly into the CRM during live conversations, without relying on handwritten notes for later entry. Capture contact details, service needs, commitments, and next steps completely and accurately.
* Respond to online quote requests within 5 minutes of submission, return client calls within 5 minutes, and respond to emails, texts, and calls daily in accordance with company procedures.
* Schedule repair and replacement appointments, service calls, estimates, and final 25 Point roof inspections. Confirm appointment details, start dates, times, and any changes promptly with clients and the appropriate staff.
* Coordinate and dispatch repair inspections and production calls under the direction of the Production Manager. Make proactive scheduling decisions within established guidelines to support profitable dispatching, productive technician time, efficient travel, and timely client service.
* Monitor the schedule for gaps, conflicts, delays, and changing priorities. Take action to keep
    
  appointments moving, communicate adjustments, and escalate decisions that exceed your authority.
* Generate sales orders in the CRM, record and verify appointment results, and follow up with the responsible staff when results or supporting details are missing. Keep administrative tracking systems updated daily.
* Prepare complete, accurate production and job folders, including jobs with signed proposals and deposits awaiting contracts. Ensure repair and replacement paperwork reaches the appropriate staff before appointments.
* Route required job pouches to management for commission entry and review. Transfer completed job folders to the Office Manager for invoicing and send contracts for electronic signatures as directed.
* Collect required payments and payment information on booked and confirmed calls, following company procedures for authorization, accurate processing, documentation, and protection of client information.
* Assist clients who choose financing and complete vendor warranty registrations after final invoicing. Track outstanding documents and follow through until required administrative steps are complete.
* Provide prompt support to technicians and sales representatives. Maintain clear communication so that client commitments, appointment requirements, and job information are understood across the team.
* Follow up daily with clients who have requested communication. Resolve service concerns promptly, respectfully, and with empathy; provide daily updates to the Sales Manager on escalated interactions and support a quality or recommendation score of at least 9/10 through PulseM or an equivalent system.
* Report directly to the Sales Manager, meet weekly to review goals and results, and attend meetings and required training prepared and on time. Participate in phone skills training at least twice yearly and help improve scripts and processes.
* Maintain organized records and work areas, meet reporting deadlines, and promptly notify management of serious accidents, damage, liability or warranty concerns, fraud, theft, or serious Core Value breaches.

**QUALIFICATIONS FOR A SERVICE OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

* Prior experience in service coordination, dispatch, appointment scheduling, client care, or administrative operations. Experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, or another trade service business is strongly preferred.
* Comfort managing a high volume of phone calls while completing time-sensitive scheduling, dispatch, and administrative responsibilities.
* Fast, accurate keyboarding and the ability to listen, ask questions, and type directly into a CRM during a live conversation without first taking handwritten notes. Strong typing speed must be matched by accuracy and complete records.
* Sound judgment and confidence making timely decisions within established procedures, with the ability to recognize when management input is needed.
* Proven ability to work independently, take initiative, anticipate needs, and follow responsibilities through to completion without repeated reminders.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to checking names, addresses, appointment times, payments, and job documentation for accuracy.
* Ability to shift quickly between tasks, manage interruptions, and maintain a productive pace in a busy environment with changing priorities and firm deadlines.
* Practical, analytical problem-solving skills and an understanding of how booking, scheduling, dispatch, and follow-up affect productivity, revenue, and profitability.
* Clear verbal and written communication, professional phone skills, and the ability to explain service options and respond to objections while treating clients respectfully.
* Confidence using CRM systems, scheduling tools, email, spreadsheets, and multiple computer applications, with the ability to learn new systems and follow established workflows.
* Integrity, discretion with confidential information, dependable attendance, a positive work ethic, and a willingness to accept coaching and improve performance.

**SERVICE AREAS**

This is a full-time onsite position at our company offices in Oley, PA, supporting clients and field operations throughout Berks County and surrounding areas, including Reading and Allentown, PA.

**ARE YOU READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM**

Do you enjoy taking ownership of a busy schedule, solving practical problems, and keeping details accurate while the phones are ringing? Are you ready to combine excellent client care with the initiative and judgment that help a service business succeed? If our mission, Core Values, and expectations resonate with you, complete our quick, mobile-friendly application today. All applications are confidential. We look forward to meeting you!

**Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!**

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

* **Customer Obsession:** Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.
* **Embracing New Ideas:** Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.
* **Striving for Excellence:** Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

**The Opportunity:**

**ENTRY LEVEL CAREER OPPORTUNITY OFFERING:**

* Paid Certifications
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Comprehensive Benefits
* Career Advancement
* This position pays between $17.00 - $18.15/hr based on experience

**\*\*\*This position is an onsite role, and candidates must be able to work on-site at Tower - Reading Hospital in Wyomissing, PA.**

**Available Shifts:**

* **PRN** Must be able to work any shift and Holidays

We are searching for the next Patient Access Specialist champion. This role is responsible for performing admitting duties for all patients admitted for services at the hospital. They are responsible for performing these functions while meeting the mission and goals of the organization and all regulatory compliance requirements. The Representative will work within the policies and processes as they are being performed across the entire organization.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Patient Access staff are responsible for assigning accurate MRNs, completing medical necessity / compliance checks, providing proper patient instructions, collecting insurance information, receiving, and processing physician orders, and utilizing an overlay tool while providing excellent customer service as measured by Press Ganey.
* Operates the telephone switchboard to relay incoming, outgoing, and inter-office calls as applicable.
* They are to adhere to policies and provide excellent customer service in these interactions with the appropriate level of compassion.
* Patient Access staff will be held accountable for point of service goals as assigned.
* Patient Access staff are responsible for the utilization of quality auditing and reporting systems to ensure accounts are corrected. These activities may include accounts for other employees, departments, and facilities. Conducts audits of accounts and assures that all forms are completed accurate, timely to meet audit standards and provides statistical data to Patient Access leadership.
* Patient Access Staff are responsible for the pre-registration of patient accounts prior to patient visits. This may include inbound and outbound calling to obtain demographic, insurance, and other patient information including the patient financial liabilities including collecting point of service collections as well as past due balances including payment plan options.
* The Patient Access Staff explains general consent for treatment forms to the patient/guarantor/legal guardian, obtains necessary signatures and witness’s name. Explains and distributes patient education documents, such as Important Message from Medicare, Important Message from Tricare, Observation Forms, MOON form, Consent forms, and all forms implemented for future services.
* Reviews eligibility responses in insurance verification system and appropriately selects the applicable insurance plan code, enters benefit data into system to support POS (Point of Service Collections) and billing processes to assist with a clean claim rate.
* Responsible for accurately screening of medical necessity using the Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN) software to inform Medicare patients of possible non-payment of test by Medicare and distribution of the ABN as appropriate. Responsible for distribution and documentation of other designated forms and pamphlets.

**Experience We Love:**

* 1+ years of customer service experience
* Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

**Minimum Education:**

* High School Diploma/GED Required

**Certifications:**

* CRCR Required within 9 months of hire (Company Paid)

da0ad46d7941d80d0805.description:
NELSON is currently seeking a highly motivated and team-oriented **Project Manager** to join our **Hospitality Practice**. The Project Manager is responsible for balancing the performance and process of multiple projects of varying size and scope. The Project Manager is responsible to advance the opportunities for continued growth in market share, profitability in specific service lines, practice areas and/or local market. Experience with ground up projects in the Hospitality sector is strongly preferred.

  

**Attributes to support the NELSON culture:**

* **Go All In. Own the Outcome.**We go all in—with urgency, follow-through, and pride in the result.
* **Be Direct. Be Respectful. Be Authentic.**We keep it real—with clarity, candor, and care.
* **Grow with Purpose.**We embrace growth—through learning, coaching, and continuous improvement.
* **Think Bold. Execute Smart.**We think boldly—and pair ambition with discipline.
* **Make Space for Everyone.**We value you—and build a culture where people can thrive and do their best work.

  

**Qualifications**:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Critical features of this job are described under the headings below. They may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons.

  

**Required Knowledge and Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of design, trends, construction methodology, materials application, and manufacturer-supplier appropriateness
* Basic knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, drawings, and models
* Basic knowledge of sustainability, integrated design, and LEED guidelines
* Ability to “salvage” troubled Clients, accounts, and/or projects
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations, Life Safety codes, building systems, and ADA requirements
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally, graphically and in writing
* Proficiency in contract administration
* Proficiency to organize, prioritize and effectively meet deadlines and provide high quality service to clients.
* Strong working knowledge in project management/planning software; Deltek VantagePoint preferred (Project Planning, Contract Management, Resource Management, and more)
* Working knowledge of HubSpot CRM, MS Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Project, etc.
* Good understanding of Revit, AutoCAD/Architectural Desktop
* General understanding of NewForma and BlueBeam Revu preferred, but not required
* Good working knowledge of AIA Documents and other contract types
* Good writing skills to develop proposals to Clients with a clear understanding of scope of work and fee
* Basic contract understanding, include terms and conditions, and best practices for contracting with Clients and Consultants

  

##### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:**

*Resource Management:*

* Create and maintain project plans in Deltek Project Planning / VantagePoint in support of resource planning and accurate revenue projections
* Meet weekly with the project team to outline and review work progress, schedule adjusting and effectively communicating changes to teams, consultants, and clients as needed
* Participate in local/regional project meetings to review project staffing and resource management
* Ensure all direct reports and project teammates are fully utilized, engaging the use of extended teams whenever possible, and coordinating with other Project Managers and Studio Leaders, as necessary
* Review and approve teammates’ time sheets for accuracy in terms of recording time on the correct project and project phase

*Project Delivery:*

* Manage and lead the Key Project Management Functions: Fee, Scope, and Schedule for all required projects
* Lead meetings with project team on a regular basis to monitor projects for conformance to project plan, schedules, budgets, and contract
* Course correct project and develop a plan of action if the project deviates from the project plan
* Develop, lead, and communicate expectations for the project to achieve client satisfaction. Partner with (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer to establish both quantitative and qualitative project goals and objectives with the project team and hold the project team accountable for attaining them. Provide actionable project level guidance to Studio Leader and/or Operations Director and/or Business Leader on project status, staffing requirements, and course correction for projects that are not meeting the project plan (Fee, Scope, Schedule)
* Facilitate on boarding of extended teammates to be included in project. Partner with (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer in generating scope of service to be provided by extended teams
* Manage the project contract performance and process, understanding the scope, budget, and quality agreed to by the Client
* Execute the contract in alignment with approved work plans, schedules, and budgets to attain profitability targets to manage and monitor the project life cycle and financial outcome of the project
* Lead or assist the (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer communication with consultants, vendors, and contractors and provide support / confirm they are meeting the project requirements
* Assist (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer in scheduling design and QA/QC reviews at each stage of the project. The architectural review and technical process is established by the QA/QC team which would include Technical Leaders. The Project Manager is to coordinate drawing review according to the QA/QC protocol
* Monitor communication between project team and client to ensure design intent and documentation is within the scope of the contract. If there is a deviation, communicate this to the owner and project team to resolve the deviation
* Contribute to and offer professional opinion to Leadership Team of the firm regarding current projects, staff, client relationships, etc.
* Create (or oversee) and issue project notes for internal team as necessary
* Create (or oversee) and issue project meeting minutes for distribution to Client and/or Consultants as necessary. Complete timesheet daily, confirming accuracy prior to submission
* Complete expense reports timely, confirming accuracy prior to submission
* Review and approve teammates’ time sheets and expenses for accuracy in terms of recording time & expense the correct project and project phase

*Technical:*

* Conduct initial review of drawings, documents, proposals, prior to other reviews ensuring accuracy and completeness and compliance with the contract
* Guide teammates in utilizing all NELSON resources within their office, within the team/account, and across the network to deliver quality technical and/or creative design
* Maintain and archive electronic project files
* Partner with Studio Leader to coordinate training for teammates as needed for Revit, MS Office, rendering software, 3D modeling or any other software needs

*Financial & Contract Management:*

* Develop and lead the creation of scope of work, schedule a fee for new projects
* Create and issue RFP documents for Consultant engagement when necessary
* Effectively negotiate contracts with Clients and Consultants under the guidance of NELSON Legal team and Business/Project Delivery Leader
* Review contracts and legal issues with NELSON's legal department and Business or Project Delivery Leader
* Create and maintain contracts with consultants and Clients, including add services, for the project duration
* Review contracts and legal issue with Nelson's legal department
* Project Manager is responsible for meeting Key Performance Indicators on all projects, including Effective Multiplier, Gross Margin, Profitability, Realization, and Accounts Receivable
* Initiate project set up and input information in to Deltek VantagePoint using the project planning and project modules
* Manage project using the Deltek VantagePoint; complete work plans; including identification of Teammate assignments to skill sets, schedule for completion, project budget, consultants, fees, and labor costs as well as project change notices or other actions taking place on the assigned project. Review with your Project Analyst to ensure projects are being set up appropriately
* Manage project invoices and provide draft mark ups monthly within the requested deadline. Review and work with billing team to approve consultant invoices monthly within requested deadlines
* Monitor Client payment status to ensure timely payment from Client. If payment extends beyond contract limits notify Studio Leader and/or Business Leader. Lead the engagement as needed
* Monitor Consultant payments to ensure payments are made within the Contract limits. Communicate with consultants as to the status of payments
* As needed, generate add service agreements for scope of work that is outside of contract. Coordinate fee if required by consultants. Update and maintain within Deltek VantagePoint

*Client Relationship:*

* Function as the primary Client contact through all phases of the project
* Maintain positive client relationships throughout project. Keep Client apprised of project progress on regular basis
* Assist Client in obtaining bids and awarding construction contracts if required
* Foster relationships with Clients, Vendors, Brokers, Consultants etc. and engage with them on a personal level as well as work to gain their confidence

*Business Development:*

* Participate in marketing and business development opportunities as requested
* Develop work plans, fee proposals and project schedules in response to RFP’s and other opportunities
* Nurture professional relationships with Clients on an ongoing basis to assist with business development for the firm
* Participate as requested in meetings with leadership team to share ideas regarding existing and overall organization, business development opportunities, position in the marketplace, etc.
* Participate in new project interviews to present NELSON capabilities, particularly related to project delivery, as requested

*Leadership:*

* Inspire a positive team environment
* Encourage communication with all levels of the team
* Support the team. Be approachable, supportive, and encouraging
* Collaborate with other teams when necessary
* Effectively manage Teammates to maintain positive interaction, while ensuring the highest product quality, meeting client expectations on budget and on time
* Participate in interviews and recruiting of professional staff as requested
* Enhance the work and careers of Teammates through continuous training, support, and mentoring including project management, contract understanding, project planning, invoicing, and an understanding of how the project financial goals fit into the overall financial health of the firm
* Work alongside (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer and Studio Leader to schedule teammates, etc. with success; respecting each other’s responsibilities to achieve desired outcomes
* Provide consistent and constructive feedback to Designers, Architects, etc. and assist the (Senior) Architect/Interior Designer and Studio Leader by providing Teammates with opportunities to achieve professional goals
* Contribute as a leader, on an as-needed basis relating to individual performance & development within the project team
* Embrace specific steps to create, develop, and promote a diverse workforce and inclusive environment

**Continuing Education and Professional Development:**

* Maintain licensure by fulfilling continuing education requirements
* Continuously enhance skills in required software by attending in-house training and working on billable projects
* Enhance management and communication skills

##### **Education / Experience:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Architecture from an accredited University plus:
* 8+ years' experience; or equivalent in appropriate education and experience working in the field of Architecture
* Experience with ground up projects in the Hospitality sector is strongly preferred

  

Average national salary range: $70,000 – $140,000 (compensation factors are based upon years of relevant experience, qualifications/licensure, education, location, etc.). Additional compensation includes bonuses and benefits. Bonuses can include but are not limited to: Long Term Incentive Plan, Short Term Incentive Plan, Profit Sharing

With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

**Pratt & Whitney** is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over **100 years.**

  

**Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.**

The Pratt & Whitney **Digital MES team** has an exciting **remote** opportunity available for a **MES Business Analyst** supporting the Digital Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) tower.

**What You Will Do:**

Pratt & Whitney, an RTX company, is looking for a functional business analyst to join our PW Digital team, supporting the Digital Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) tower.

  

This individual will be involved in the delivery of designing, developing, enhancing, and implementing software solutions within Pratt & Whitney’s Center of Excellence (COE) for enterprise MES, as well as integrations with other enterprise products for our internal Operations customers.

  

This role will support creation of functional specifications, contributing to system design decisions, and managing within the software development lifecycle.

Career growth opportunities include access and exposure to technical and functional experts, business operations, and to executives and upper management. This position offers an opportunity to network with technical professionals and to build relationships within the organization being on the front lines of developing technology.

The Digital MES team at Pratt and Whitney is looking for a highly motivated, self-starter who will be excited in delivering digital solutions within our MES & Manufacturing Operations Management enterprise platform as it relates to supporting our facilities worldwide.

  

Specific focus includes process planning and manufacturing execution, as well as integration to Pratt and Whitney’s SAP ERP and other enterprise solutions.

  

Current strategic activities include supporting the strategic MES Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO) roadmap, deploying next-gen solutions, new site implementations, and integrating with new technologies for IIOT and Industry 4.0.

**Specific responsibilities will include but are not limited to:**

* Bridging gaps between business processes and MES functionality & capabilities.

* Translating customer requirements into a solution design.

* Authoring of functional specifications.

* Troubleshooting business process against system capabilities.

* Engaging with DevOps solution management.

* Task Management with a strong follow-up discipline.

* Skills around system testing and coordination.

* Skills to support process mapping and solution design.

* Skills with navigating and operating in an Agile methodology.

* Skills with JIRA in support of DevOps management.

* Skills regarding system workflow and UI configuration.

* Meeting all budget, deliverable, and schedule targets.

* Production and end user support for MES solutions.

* Supporting integration with other enterprise solutions.

* Working with internal customers and external suppliers, business partners, to architect and build system solutions for using the latest technologies to satisfy requirements.

* Managing suppliers and partners to schedule and status resources required for solution development and implementation.

* Work on multiple projects simultaneously with regular reporting in a gated process.

* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Author and/or provide input to system functional requirements, technical design documentation and test plans.

* Work with business teams to plan and implement projects/enhancements

Ensuring compliance with RTX / PW policies & procedures.

The position is based remotely and up to 10% domestic/international travel may be required. Due to customer locations in different time zones, customer meetings can occur outside normal business work hours.

**Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related degree and 8+ years of experience in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related field; **OR** an Advanced Degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related degree and 5+ years of experience in Computer Science, MIS, Business, Engineering, or related field.

Required Qualifications:

* **U.S. Citizenship is required** (required due to Government contractual requirements).

**Qualifications We Prefer:**

* 3+ years’ experience with MES disciplines including, but not limited to, process planning and work order execution.

* MRO or aftermarket processes knowledge.

* Knowledge of other manufacturing solutions.

* Ability to translate business requirements to functional specifications.

* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical people, explain functional requirements to technical developers.

* Quick learner of existing system capabilities and structure.

* Prior experience in software development (JAVA, SQL, etc…) although development is not a primary responsibility.

* Detail oriented, analytical and able to trace problems.

* Strong communication skills.

* Team player with strong follow up skills and ability to craft positive relationships.

* Excellent judgment and professional business maturity.

* Strong working knowledge Microsoft Office.

* Self-starter with the ability to spot potential for process improvement.

**Learn More & Apply Now:**

**What is my role type?**

In addition to transforming the future of flight, we are also transforming how and where we work. We’ve introduced role types to help you understand how you will operate in our blended work environment.

**This role is:**

This role will act as the operation’s customer support system. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

* Verifies merchandise by matching customer and sales receipt information.

* Resolves customer service issues by identifying and explaining the best solution, taking the appropriate action, and following up to ensure complete resolution.

* Prepares quality reports, load out reports, dispatch logs and tracking logs, and set up of manifests

* Manages exceptions not limited to late departures or arrivals, breakdowns, in-home service time, not at home, go backs, accidents, product or in-home damages, delivery team illness or injury.

#### **Position Overview**

Forge Hospitality is looking for an energetic Sales Coordinator to join the sales team at our Holiday Inn in Morgantown. This role plays a key role in supporting the sales team by assisting with administrative tasks related to group bookings, events, and catering services. This is an entry-level position ideal for someone looking to start a career in hotel sales and hospitality or a strong front desk agent looking to take the next step in their career. The role involves a mix of customer service, event coordination, and sales support, and offers an opportunity to grow within the company.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver exceptional service to guests, clients, and internal team members.
* Support the Sales Team by preparing group contracts, event documentation, and client communications as directed.
* Assist in creating Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) for catering events and help coordinate event details with clients and the hotel operations team.
* Handle inquiries and walkins for group and meeting room bookings, ensuring information is passed to the correct sales representative.
* Help manage group room blocks by entering rooming lists, confirming details with clients, and ensuring the Front Desk team has uptodate information.
* Follow up on group and event bookings, ensuring all documentation is completed accurately and sales systems are uptodate.
* Help update and maintain marketing materials and hotel collateral.
* Assist with site tours, promotional activities, sales calls, and customer outreach as needed.
* Maintain open communication with all hotel departments to ensure smooth coordination of events and bookings.
* Assist with social media updates and marketing efforts as directed.
* Perform other administrative tasks as required by the sales team.

#### **Qualifications**

* No prior experience required, though a strong interest in sales or hospitality is a plus.
* Hotel front desk, catering, or administrative experience is a plus.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Comfortable working with computers and learning new software programs.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
* Friendly, approachable, and a team player.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.

#### **Why Join Forge Hospitality?**

At Forge Hospitality, you’ll find more than a career — you’ll discover a place where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your impact is felt across every property we manage.

* Be part of a company where values aren’t just words — they shape everything we do.
* Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
* Comprehensive benefits, including health, retirement, and travel discount perks.

#### **About Forge Hospitality LLC**

Forge Hospitality is a dynamic hospitality management company dedicated to creating memorable guest experiences and delivering operational excellence. We pride ourselves on innovation, service, and a culture that values collaboration and results.

**Employment Type:** Salaried  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Event & Marketing Services Specialist plays a key role in bringing our brand to life through exceptional event execution and marketing support. This role owns the planning and execution of select channel‑specific events while supporting the Senior Manager on major industry programs. The Specialist manages event logistics and promotional inventory, and coordinates essential workflows to ensure our teams are prepared and our events are executed flawlessly. The ideal candidate is detail‑oriented, organized, and thrives in a role centered on structured execution.

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------------

* Event Logistics & Industry Event Support  
  Coordinate logistics and execution of select channel‑specific events (e.g., NACS, IDDBA, Pizza Expo) and support the planning of major industry events (MenuMasters, IFMA COEX, IFDA). Responsibilities include supporting event planning timelines, coordinating registration and materials, assisting with vendor communication, preparing and shipping event assets, and supporting on‑site event readiness. Partner with internal teams to ensure events are organized, well‑prepared, and consistently represent the brand. Support tradeshow lead generation program by assisting with monthly reporting related to event participation, lead capture results, and overall program performance.
* Promotional Inventory & Fulfillment Management  
  Support fulfillment and promotional inventory operations by partnering closely with an external agency that monitors stock levels and provides reorder recommendations. This role is responsible for reviewing and securing internal approvals for reorders, coordinating reorder requests, managing vendor communication, and tracking associated budgets and expenses. Ensuring all promotional materials (oil kits, racks, pumps, and food show collateral) are accurate, approved, and aligned with brand standards before being produced or restocked. Maintains organized internal documentation and ensures timely distribution to field teams.
* Digital Asset & Content Maintenance  
  Help maintain, update, and coordinate the production of digital marketing assets and promotional materials, including ads, sell sheets, signage, and branded materials. Partner with internal teams, external vendors, and the agency managing our Marketing Dashboard platform to ensure all materials are accurate, approved, on brand, and delivered on time. Maintain organized asset libraries so internal and external teams have access to current, easy‑to‑use resources that support event readiness, field execution, and customer engagement.
* Administrative & Budget Support  
  Processes invoices, submits purchase orders, tracks expenses, and updates budget tracking spreadsheets for marketing materials, promotional inventory, and event‑related expenses. Assist with internal communications and day‑to‑day coordination across teams.
* Travel up to 25%
* Additional responsibilities as assigned.

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's or Associate's degree in Marketing, Business, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered, including 3 to 4 years of relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree.
* 2-4 years of experience in event planning, hospitality, project management, or a related field.
* Prior experience leading coordinating events, vendors, or logistics strongly preferred.
* Experience providing deliverables on time against deadlines.
* Proven ability to collaborate successfully with internal and external partners.
* Excellent grasp of digital and social media usage for event marketing and other marketing tactics.

**Knowledge and Skills:**
-------------------------

* Strong project coordination skills with proven ability to manage timelines and deliver against deadlines.
* Strong organizational, communication, and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and capable of managing multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills; comfortable working cross‑functionally.
* Working knowledge of marketing materials, POS, promotions, or event execution.
* Ability to manage vendors, interpret budgets, and track accurate spend.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook).
* Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce), marketing automation, or inventory management tools beneficial but not required.
* Self‑starter who thrives in a fast‑paced, execution‑focused environment.

**Why Join Us:**

Ventura Foods innovates and manufactures food solutions for foodservice and retail businesses. We make exclusive products for the world's most iconic restaurants and retailers, we provide ready-to-go product solutions for professional kitchens, and we make consumer brands everyone knows and loves. When you work for Ventura Foods, you get a strong foundation of training, a manager who cares about you and celebrates your success, a safe environment, and challenging work. As part of our team, your future is limited only by how much you’re willing to push yourself to get there. We invest in your growth because you invest in ours.

Ventura Foods offers career growth opportunities as well as competitive compensation and benefits:

* Medical, Prescription, Dental, & Vision – coverage beginning on your 1st day for eligible employees
* Profit Sharing and 401(k) matching (after eligible criteria is met)
* Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Holidays
* Employee Appreciation Events and Employee Assistance Programs
* Salary Base Range of $55,407.80 - $83,778.03\*

* The “base salary range” provided above is a good faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position in the specified markets. Ventura Foods reserves the right to pay outside of the given range based on a variety of factors including but not limited to: candidate skills and experience, complexity of the job, budgetary factors, and location/geography. Ventura Foods conducts regular reviews of compensation ranges and therefore reserves the right to alter this range at any given time.

**Our Culture**  
Our Culture reflects our commitment to treating every employee with respect and creating an environment where people can do their best work. We rely on a variety of strengths, backgrounds, and experiences across our teams to help us innovate, grow, and deliver for our customers. By fostering a workplace that is supportive, collaborative, and grounded in integrity, we continue to attract strong talent and meet the high expectations of a rapidly evolving marketplace.

We regularly review our tools to promote fairness and reduce the risk of bias. However, while these tools support our process, every hiring decision is made by a real person on our team. ac4e81fe4a0d70fdb2df.description:
**About Vector Airport Systems**

Vector Airport Systems is an established international aviation software and services company with a positive team culture and an emphasis on visionary leadership. Our hard-working, innovative team delivers aircraft tracking, revenue generation, and mission-critical SaaS solutions to our clients.

With our PLANEPASS® service, we provide an outsourced, end-to-end accounts receivable management solution to airports. We are seeking an experienced Customer Service Specialist to join our PLANEPASS® team and help deliver our proven revenue solution to our clients.

**About the Position**

As a Customer Service Specialist, you will be a primary point of contact for our PLANEPASS® service, responding to inbound phone and email inquiries, clarifying account and invoice details, researching questions, and resolving issues with accuracy and professionalism. You will document each interaction in our CRM, coordinate with internal teams when escalation is needed, and follow through to ensure timely resolution.  
  
You will additionally spend approximately 10% of your time assisting the collections team as needed, including helping customers with payment questions and conducting professional follow-up on past-due balances.  
  
We are seeking a confident professional who can communicate clearly and effectively, manage multiple priorities, and maintain a positive and professional rapport with all clients.

This is a fully remote, full-time position. To serve our Pacific Time Zone customers, we are seeking candidates who are available from 8:00am to 4:00pm Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Respond to inbound customer inquiries by phone and email, providing timely, accurate, and professional assistance.
* Research account, invoice, and payment questions; explain findings clearly and work toward first-contact resolution whenever possible.
* Resolve customer concerns and complaints with professionalism, escalating complex issues to the appropriate team when needed.
* Precisely document and log customer interactions using Vector’s internal CRM software platform.
* Maintain Vector’s success rate by applying established methods and customer service standards to meet and exceed goals.

**Supporting Responsibilities:**

* Gain a working knowledge of aviation industry terminology and business practices through ongoing on-the-job training.
* Research accounts using available company records and internet resources.
* Collaborate with team members to find greater efficiency, new methods, or process improvements to bring in more revenue and find success as a group – Vector is all about teams working to achieve greater outcomes.
* Adapt to changing priorities, new procedures, and evolving customer needs while maintaining quality and productivity.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* Minimum of 3 years in a dedicated customer support or service role responding to inbound customer inquiries by phone and/or email. Qualifying experience must be clearly demonstrated in the employment history provided on your resume.
* Experience researching and explaining account, invoice, billing, or payment information
* Proficiency with CRM systems and the Microsoft Office 365 suite
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including active listening and clear explanations
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and accurate documentation habits
* Ability to prioritize multiple customer needs and adapt to changes in workflow
* Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment when resolving or escalating issues
* A collaborative, customer-focused attitude that supports team and company goals
* Ability to work 8:00am to 4:00pm Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.

**Vector Workplace**

We strive to be a terrific place to work, emphasizing teamwork, initiative, and results. The doors of Senior Leadership are always open. In additional to our benefits program, we are proud to offer a workplace with:

* Generous rewards for hard work and dedication.
* Leadership takes a constructive interest in every team member’s success.
* Our cultural focus on people and results - not bureaucracy and arbitrary rules.
* Work/Life Balance is respected and encouraged.
* Be part of a team that enjoys time together and helps each other succeed.
* You will not be micromanaged: Plan, prioritize and schedule your own tasks.

**How To Apply**

To be considered for the position, please follow the instructions below carefully when applying. Applicants that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

* Your resume must clearly demonstrate the minimum qualifications and experience required for this position.

* Resume File Naming: The file name of your resume should be your last name, first name, and requisition ID2645 in the following format: **LastName\_FirstName\_ID2645**

* Application Completion: Please complete the application in full to be considered for the position. While we understand AI tools have become a useful resource, all application submissions and written responses must reflect your own experience, knowledge, and communication style.

**Hiring Process**

Our goal is to ensure a fair, transparent, and engaging process for every candidate. Here’s what you can expect once your application is submitted:

* Assessment: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a brief online assessment.

* First Round Video Interview: Selected candidates will participate in an initial video interview.

* Final Interview: Top candidates will participate in a final video interview before we make our final selection

Vector Airport Systems is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regards to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.
